# Account Manager

**Hybrid**Client

London, England, United Kingdom

## Description

**We're on a mission to make banking 10x better.**

At 10x Banking ("ten-*ex*banking") we're transforming the financial industry with our cloud-native core banking platform. 10x's platform powers global banks and financial institutions including Chase UK, Old Mutual and Westpac.

We offer a diverse, global community that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Tackling exciting challenges with the utmost integrity, we aim to make a positive impact through our work for our clients, their customers and the communities we work in.

Be part of something bigger - join us and transform and industry.

**About the role**

The Account Manager is responsible for the end-to-end commercial and relationship management of one or more of 10x's banking clients. Acting as the primary interface between 10x and assigned client organisations, you will be accountable for building strong executive relationships, tracking contractual commitments, and aligning 10x's capabilities and delivery plans to client objectives.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders within client organisations and across 10x to drive successful client outcomes, manage commercial discussions and ensure risks, issues and dependencies are effectively identified and managed.

You will act as the voice of the client within 10x, bringing together teams across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Commercial and Executive Leadership to ensure clients realise maximum value from the 10x platform.

**About you**

You are collaborative, commercially minded and self-motivated, with experience managing enterprise customer accounts within a SaaS, technology, consulting or financial services environment.

You have a proven track record of owning client relationships, managing large commercial agreements and balancing customer needs with business objectives. You understand the challenges faced by banks and can translate client requirements into commercially sound and operationally achievable outcomes.

You are an excellent communicator who is comfortable engaging with stakeholders at all levels, from delivery teams through to executive leadership. You thrive in fast-paced environments, are naturally inquisitive, and bring strong judgement, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

**Key responsibilities**

* Experience or ability to own strategic relationships with one or more of 10x's banking clients, acting as the primary point of commercial engagement.
* Experience or ability to build trusted relationships with client executives and key stakeholders, ensuring a strong understanding of their priorities, challenges and strategic objectives.
* Manage commercial aspects of client contracts, including negotiations, renewals, contractual changes and the delivery of agreed commercial outcomes.
* Work closely with Client Delivery Managers and internal stakeholders to ensure client commitments are delivered successfully and in line with agreed plans.
* Support Client Delivery Managers in identifying, managing and escalating risks, issues and dependencies that may impact client outcomes.
* Oversee changes to client roadmaps, ensuring appropriate governance, stakeholder alignment and communication across all affected teams.
* Facilitate discussions between clients and internal stakeholders to resolve challenges, make informed decisions and maintain delivery momentum.
* Provide clear visibility of client priorities, risks and opportunities to senior leadership, including members of the Executive Committee.
* Support the ongoing development of client engagement standards, governance processes and best practices across 10x.

## Requirements

**Ideally you will have...**

* Experience managing strategic enterprise client accounts within a SaaS, technology, consulting or financial services environment.
* Experience owning complex customer relationships and influencing stakeholders across both client and internal organisations.
* Strong commercial acumen, including experience working with high-value contracts, negotiations and account governance.
* The ability to understand and discuss complex technology products with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working with banking clients, or a strong understanding of banking technology, core banking platforms and industry trends.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build credibility at all organisational levels.
* Experience facilitating meetings, governance forums and commercial discussions that drive clear outcomes and decisions.
* Experience developing and maintaining plans, tracking dependencies and coordinating activities across multiple workstreams.
* Experience working within agile technology environments and collaborating with product and delivery teams.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience using SharePoint, OneDrive or similar collaboration and document management tools.

## Benefits

At 10x Banking, we believe in empowering you to get the job done! Our benefits are here to support you be the best you can be.

* 25 days of holiday in addition to Bank/Public Holidays (with the option to swap some public holidays for alternative dates such as Diwali or Eid)
* 1 day off on or around your birthday
* 4 wellbeing days (1 additional paid day off per quarter, aimed at supporting you to maintain your personal wellbeing)
* Remote enabled working: scroll down to see the office requirements for this role
* Enhanced parental policies, including time off for fertility treatment
* Regular social gatherings and affinity groups
* Work from anywhere outside your typical working location - up to 4 weeks a year
* Career progression and learning pathways
* 1 paid volunteering day a year
* Sabbatical leave
* Options pool
* Private health insurance, with the option to add your family
* Pension scheme
* Enhanced company sick pay
* Life Assurance
* Income Protection
* Subscription to Headspace wellbeing app
* Flexible benefits via salary sacrifice

**More about 10x**

We are driven by the belief that whatever we do as a business has to be done in the right way. Our three core values of: Transformation, Integrity and Impact support this.

Discover what life is like at 10x over on Instagram and find out what the company is up to on LinkedIn.

**10x Ways of Working**We recognise that a better work/life balance can improve people's motivation, performance and overall wellbeing. That's why if there's scope in the working day, we have flexibility around our core hours to do the things that matter to you.

We also know some work is done better at home and some is done better in the office, and that a one-size-fits-all approach doesn't enable high performance. That's why 10x is a remote-enabled organisation and supports agile working. **This role has an office attendance requirement of approx. 1 day per week**, in agreement with your line manager.

Additionally, everyone comes together at our quarterly 10x Together Days to collaborate, align on strategy, and socialise. As all employees are employed on London-based contracts, commuting costs to the office are covered by employees and not by 10x.

**Equal opportunities for all**

At 10x, we are passionate about our people and are committed to fostering a more diverse and inclusive culture. We are building a community where every 10xer can bring their authentic self to work and feel empowered to reach their full potential. Our many employee networks help amplify this vision.

Alongside assessing technical capabilities to do the role, our assessment process will identify what you can uniquely bring to our 10x teams, and the potential you have to thrive here. Common to every role that 10xers perform, are 3 core competencies that we look for in our future 10xers - **Business Impact**, **Change Driver** & **Delivery Excellence.**

This role offers the opportunity to contribute significantly to our team's charter, direction, and roadmap by defining technical goals, addressing customer problems, maintaining production models, and ensuring operational excellence. Contribute to the development of machine learning algorithms and models for behavioral modeling and cybersecurity attack detection.

Work with infrastructure & product engineers to productionize models and new ML-based features
Monitor and improve production models through feature engineering, rules, and ML modeling as part of a team effort.

London, United Kingdom; Manchester, United Kingdom; Newcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom

**The Role**

The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. **Client Measurement & Data Strategy**

• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.

• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.

• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.

• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.

• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.

**Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving**

• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.

• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.

• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.

• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.

• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.

• Drive innovation across APVision and future analytical capabilities.

**Data Enablement & Industry Thought Leadership**

• Increase data literacy across Account Management, Strategy and Sales teams through training programmes, workshops and playbooks.

• Coach teams to ask better questions, interpret data effectively and communicate insights to clients.

• Represent AP externally as a thought leader on measurement and analytics, speaking at conferences, webinars and client forums.

• Produce thought leadership on attribution, incrementality, MMM, AI and partnership measurement, and build relationships with key industry vendors and platforms.

**By 6 Months**

The Director has built strong relationships with key enterprise client stakeholders and is actively advising on measurement strategy and programme audits. They have an established working relationship with their Data Strategist and a clear view of AP's data and analytics roadmap. Early training and enablement sessions have begun to raise data literacy across Account Management and Strategy teams.

**By 1 Year**

The Director is recognized internally and externally as AP's leading voice on measurement and analytics. Clients are adopting AP's measurement recommendations, and client satisfaction and retention have improved. The Director has contributed to new business wins, launched at least one new analytical product or framework, and represented AP at industry events. Data literacy and standardized analytical frameworks are visible across the organization, and the Data Strategist is developing well under their mentorship.

**Qualities of the Ideal Candidate:**

• Strategic thinker, comfortable operating with ambiguity

• Strong communicator and storyteller, able to simplify complex concepts for non-technical audiences

• Commercially minded

• Collaborative and influential across teams and seniority levels

• Naturally curious and innovative

• Confident representing AP as an external thought leader

**Minimum Qualifications & Skills:**

• 8–12+ years of experience in analytics, measurement, marketing science, consulting or data strategy

• Experience working with enterprise clients and advising senior stakeholders and executive teams

• Strong understanding of affiliate, influencer, digital marketing or performance marketing

• Experience leading teams and developing talent

• Strong understanding of Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), attribution methodologies and incrementality testing

• Proficiency with Google Analytics, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and Business Intelligence/dashboarding tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)

• Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and AI-enabled analytics

• SQL and data querying experience preferred

**WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?**

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership and Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing. Serving over 200 brands with household names like Amazon, Target, Google, Warby Parker, Crocs, Reebok (to name a few) their diversified staff is creating what’s next in the industry by building balanced portfolios of high-performing partnerships. As the only truly integrated global partnerships agency, Acceleration Partners prides themselves on being on the cutting edge of new industry developments, and leveraging their proven expertise to bring unique solutions to the most complex challenges for brands who aim for growth.

* 100% remote work for everyone
* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
* 401K with matching
* Open Paid Time Off
* Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December
* Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
* Focus Fridays
* Paid Parental Leave Benefits
* Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
* Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!

## About Airspeed

Airspeed is AI revenue execution. We connect signals across CRM, calls, Slack, and product systems. Our agents flag deal risk early and help teams act. They coach reps, manage follow-ups, update the CRM, and identify likely slips.

Founded by former DeepMind researchers, Airspeed now supports hundreds of revenue teams, including Persona, Menlo Security, Pricefx, and Wayflyer. We are a Series A company with approximately 40 people across London, New York, San Francisco, and Boston.

## The Opportunity

We are hiring a Finance & Revenue Operations Manager to strengthen our financial reporting, connect our finance and revenue data, and build the infrastructure required for Airspeed’s next stage of growth.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone with strong technical finance capabilities, analytical depth, and commercial judgment. You will create a trusted view of company performance by connecting financial results with the activity behind them—from pipeline and bookings through to recurring revenue, retention, margins, cash, and runway.

You will own management and investor reporting, financial planning, revenue reporting, and the models that help leadership make better decisions. You will also oversee our external accounting partners, improve the quality and control of our financial processes, and help prepare the company to bring core finance capabilities in-house as we scale.

The role combines finance, revenue operations, and transformation. You should be comfortable building a financial model, challenging a forecast, reconciling data across systems, and redesigning a manual process. You will use AI and automation to make our reporting and operations more accurate, efficient, and scalable.

This is not a general company operations, HR, office management, or administrative role. You will work closely with Airspeed’s founders, CFO, VP of GTM Strategy & Operations, and functional leaders, giving you direct exposure to the decisions and commercial drivers behind the numbers.

## What You Will Own

### Financial Planning and Reporting:

* Own the annual budget, rolling forecast, cash planning, runway analysis, and financial scenario modeling.
* Produce accurate and decision-ready management, board, and investor reporting.
* Explain what happened, why it happened, what it means for the business, and where leadership action is required.
* Maintain a trusted view of recurring revenue, bookings, retention, gross margin, burn, headcount, and unit economics.
* Support fundraising preparation, investor diligence, audit, tax, and the financial requirements associated with a future Series B.
* Oversee external accounting partners responsible for bookkeeping, management accounts, and statutory and tax reporting.
* Review and challenge externally prepared work to ensure reporting is accurate, timely, and appropriately controlled.
* Maintain oversight of billing, collections, payroll, expenses, and other core finance processes without becoming the administrative owner of every transaction.

### Revenue Operations and Commercial Insight:

* Connect financial reporting with CRM and GTM data to create one coherent view of business performance.
* Build reliable reporting across pipeline, bookings, annual recurring revenue, retention, expansion, churn, and sales efficiency.
* Own and improve revenue forecasting in partnership with sales and company leadership.
* Build models that connect pipeline generation, conversion, sales productivity, customer retention, headcount, and cash outcomes.
* Establish clear definitions and reconciled sources for core B2B SaaS metrics.
* Partner with the VP of GTM Strategy & Operations to improve reporting, planning, and decision-making across the commercial organization.
* Identify performance risks and opportunities early, then translate the data into practical recommendations for leadership.
* Develop a deep understanding of the operating and commercial drivers behind the numbers rather than reporting financial outputs in isolation.

### Systems, AI, and Automation:

* Improve and automate recurring finance and revenue operations workflows using AI, automation tools, APIs, and lightweight technical solutions.
* Replace fragile spreadsheets and manual handoffs with dependable systems, documented processes, appropriate controls, and clear ownership.
* Improve the quality, consistency, and usability of data across HubSpot, finance platforms, and connected systems.
* Build self-service dashboards and reporting tools that reduce manual requests and enable teams to access trusted information.
* Introduce clear exception handling, audit trails, and human approval for sensitive or high-stakes processes.
* Measure improvement through reporting speed, forecast accuracy, data quality, adoption, control, and manual hours removed.
* Help Airspeed operate in an AI-native way while protecting financial and commercially sensitive information.

### Building for Scale:

* Help lead the transition of core finance capabilities from external providers to an effective in-house function.
* Determine which financial processes, systems, and capabilities should be brought in-house as the company grows.
* Build reporting and planning processes that can support greater investor scrutiny, stricter deadlines, and increased organizational complexity.
* Help shape and eventually build the finance and revenue operations capabilities required as Airspeed scales.
* Establish strong practices without imposing unnecessary bureaucracy on a fast-moving Series A company.

## What Success Looks Like

Within your first several quarters:

* Leadership, the board, and investors trust the numbers and the forward forecast.
* Management and investor reporting is accurate, timely, clear, and delivered to a dependable schedule.
* Finance and revenue reporting use consistent definitions and reconciled data sources.
* Airspeed has a trusted view of pipeline, bookings, recurring revenue, retention, margins, cash, runway, and commercial performance.
* Forecasts are more accurate, risks are identified earlier, and leadership decisions are supported by clear analysis.
* External accounting partners are effectively managed and held accountable for quality, timing, and accuracy.
* High-value finance and reporting workflows are automated, monitored, and documented.
* Airspeed has a practical plan for bringing core finance capabilities in-house as the company prepares for its next stage of growth.

### About us

At Arbor, we’re on a mission to transform the way schools work for the better.

We want to make schools more joyful places to work, as well as learn.

### About the role

We are looking for an experienced and highly knowledgeable Platform Operations Director to join our Engineering team and to own the operational backbone of Arbor’s suite of applications. The remit and focus of the role is to bring together three distinct disciplines — Site Reliability Engineering, Security Engineering, and Developer Experience — under single accountable leadership, and be responsible for their outcomes across every product line and market. It’s a broad and exciting role, so we’re looking for someone up for a challenge - if you’re an effective leader and are highly collaborative, this is the role for you.

**Core responsibilities**

**Site Reliability Engineering and availability**

* Own the availability commitment. Be accountable for meeting the 99.9% availability SLA across the application suite. Define, publish, and govern the SLO and error-budget framework that makes availability measurable, forecastable, and actionable rather than retrospective.
* Build the reliability discipline. Lead the SRE pillar to embed observability, capacity planning, performance engineering, resilience testing, and toil reduction as standing practices with clear owners and cadence.
* Make reliability visible. Ensure availability, latency, and error-budget consumption are reported transparently to product teams, R&D leadership, and the executive, with credible attribution of loss to cause.
* Engineer out recurrence. Drive systemic reliability improvement through problem management, tracking repeat causes, single points of failure, and architectural weak points to closure with named owners and dates.

**Security engineering and vulnerability management**

* Own the vulnerability management framework. Define and operate the end-to-end framework for identifying, triaging, prioritising, and remediating security vulnerabilities across application code, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure, including agreed severity definitions and remediation SLAs.
* Put the reporting in place. Build the reporting and dashboards that allow the organisation — R&D leadership, the executive, and where relevant the board and customers — to monitor vulnerability burn-down and resolution against SLA, by severity, age, and owning team.
* Hold the line on remediation. Ensure vulnerabilities are resolved rather than merely recorded: drive burn-down of the existing backlog, prevent ageing, and escalate credibly where remediation is not being prioritised.
* Shift security left. Embed security into the engineering workflow through automated scanning, secure-by-default platform patterns, dependency hygiene, and practical enablement for product teams. Partner closely with security leadership and the CISO on posture, roadmap, compliance obligations, and audit evidence.

**Developer Experience and the build-it, run-it transformation**

* Lead the transformation. Own the programme of work that moves product engineering teams to “build it, run it” — taking genuine production ownership of their services, including on-call, alerting, and operational health — via a staged, evidenced adoption path rather than a mandate.
* Make the right thing the easy thing. Lead the DevX pillar to deliver the internal developer platform, golden paths, self-service tooling, CI/CD, and environment provisioning that make ownership viable for teams and reduce cognitive load.
* Treat platform as a product. Run the platform with product discipline: known internal customers, articulated service levels, adoption metrics, feedback loops, and a roadmap prioritised on developer impact.
* Measure and improve engineering throughput. Own the engineering productivity metrics — deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and time to restore — and use them to target investment where it demonstrably lifts delivery.

* Proven senior leadership of SRE, platform, or infrastructure functions at scale, with accountability for availability against a defined SLA in a customer-facing SaaS environment.
* Deep, practical command of reliability engineering: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability, capacity planning, and problem management.
* Demonstrated ownership of a major incident management process, including incident command models, on-call design, and blameless post-incident review, with evidence of materially improving MTTR.
* Track record of owning or closely partnering on security posture, including vulnerability management at scale, remediation SLAs, and reporting to executive or board level.
* Experience leading a shift to distributed production ownership (build it, run it) in an organisation that previously centralised operations.

* Credible judgement on where and how to apply AI to operational workflows, with a clear-eyed view of what to automate, what to augment, and where human accountability must remain.
* Strong track record of building and developing engineering leaders, including handling performance robustly.

* Excellent communication and influencing skills, able to operate confidently at executive level and convey technical and risk concepts to non-technical audiences, including during live incidents.

**Desirable**

# Data Engineer

#### **About Atom Learning**

We're Atom Learning and our mission is to help every child reach their potential.

We combine exceptional teacher-made content with technology, data science and machine learning to make high-quality, personalised education more accessible. Our aim is to give every child access to the kind of insight, support and individualised learning that was once largely limited to expensive private education and tutoring.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing EdTech companies. Since 2018 we've grown from a startup of four friends to over 100 people, with specialists across education, engineering, product, learning design and marketing.

The scale is real:

* Nearly **half a million children** have learned on Atom, answering more than **750 million questions**. Last academic year alone, 180,000 students answered over 210 million questions.
* **For families:** over 170,000 children have used Atom Home to build core skills and prepare for exams, answering more than **440 million questions** along the way. Our GCSE product, Home Senior, launched in February 2026 and more than **30,000 students are already learning on it**.
* **For schools:** around **1,900 schools** and more than **24,000 teachers** use Atom in the UK and internationally. Quest Progress, our standardised assessment platform, has delivered more than **1.1 million assessments** since launching in September 2024.

We're remote-first! While our main office is in London, our team of over 100 people (and counting) works across 10 countries.

#### The role

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to help shape the data platform behind some of our most important products.

Data at Atom isn't simply a reporting or support function. It powers customer-facing products that predict real-world exam outcomes, personalise what children learn next and help teachers understand where to focus their time and attention.

On our busiest days, more than **a million new question responses** flow through the platform. You'll be one of our go-to specialists for data engineering, taking ownership of how that data is collected, moved, transformed, modelled and made available across Atom.

Your impact will come in two ways. You'll contribute directly to data-powered product features, such as predicted grades, adaptive learning and exam outcome probabilities, while also helping other engineers and teams use data effectively. That might mean solving the data problem behind a new customer feature, helping an engineer navigate an unfamiliar part of the data platform, or creating tooling and patterns that make trusted data easier for everyone to use.

You'll work closely with engineers, product managers, education experts and colleagues across the business to turn complex problems into effective, reusable solutions.

This is a role for someone who wants to build excellent data infrastructure, but also cares deeply about what that infrastructure enables: better products, better decisions and ultimately better outcomes for learners.

#### How we work

Our culture is built on freedom, trust and high agency. We expect our engineers to be product-minded, curious and comfortable taking ownership beyond the boundaries of their specialism.

AI-assisted engineering is a core part of how we work. We use AI to learn faster, research unfamiliar problems, prototype ideas, explore alternatives and get to better solutions sooner. We believe its biggest value is in making strong engineers more capable, not simply helping them produce more code.

AI increases the amount we can execute, but it makes engineering judgement more important, not less. We value people who can work through ambiguity, decide what should be built, understand the trade-offs and take responsibility for the impact of their work rather than simply completing a well-defined task.

Your deepest expertise will be in data engineering, but you’ll understand the wider product, collaborate closely across disciplines and contribute wherever your expertise can have the greatest impact.

Our application data lives primarily in CockroachDB, with a modern data platform built around BigQuery, dbt, Airflow and pub/sub. Data flows both ways: into analytics and modelling, and back into the products our customers use.

That culture translates into a flat hierarchy with a high degree of autonomy, where engineers collaborate closely, share expertise freely and are trusted to use their judgement, shape solutions and take meaningful ownership of outcomes.

#### What you’ll do

* Build and evolve the data foundations behind customer-facing products, including predictive features, adaptive learning and assessment insights.

Job Title
Data Architect
Department
Data Services-BG-UK
Overview of Department
Purpose of Role
The Data Architect designs the technical patterns, integrations and implementation approaches that make the data architecture executable across platforms and delivery teams. The role translates enterprise and product architecture principles into concrete solution designs covering data ingestion, processing, storage, APIs, events, security, observability and operational controls. Working closely with platform engineers, software engineers, data engineers, modellers, analysts and governance teams, the Data Architect ensures that data solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned to the wider architecture vision.
Responsibilities
Technical Architecture Design - Own the technical runbook and define end-to-end technical designs for data solutions across ingestion, transformation, storage, integration, consumption and operational support.
Platform Pattern Definition - Create and evolve reusable technical patterns, reference architectures and design guardrails for data pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse design, APIs, events and analytical services.
Engineering Collaboration - Work with data engineers, platform engineers and software engineers to ensure designs are practical, buildable, testable and operationally robust.
Security and Privacy by Design - Embed appropriate access controls, encryption, masking, segregation, retention, monitoring and audit requirements into technical designs.
Data Quality and Observability - Define technical implementation patterns for validation, reconciliation, lineage capture, monitoring, alerting and incident investigation.
Performance and Scalability - Assess and optimise technical designs for latency, throughput, availability, cost, resilience and maintainability.
Integration and Interoperability - Ensure data solutions integrate effectively with source systems, domain services, data products, catalogues, governance tooling and consumption channels.
Design Assurance - Review detailed designs, code-level patterns and delivery outputs for alignment with architecture standards and accepted technology choices.
Technical Debt Management - Identify, document and prioritise remediation of architecture debt, platform constraints and implementation risks.
Technology Leadership - Maintain strong awareness of relevant data technologies, engineering practices and vendor capabilities, advising teams on appropriate adoption
​
What does success look like?
Fully documented data runbook detailing technical patterns across all technologies adopted within the data platform, with a practical maintenance and evolution plan
Design patterns are consistently adopted by engineering to efficiently deliver solutions aligned with architecture standards. Data solutions are secure, reliable and scalable. Security, privacy, data quality and observability are built into designs, with performance, resilience and cost considered from the outset. Your knowledge and experience
Strong practical architecture experience with a modern cloud data platform, advanced SQL and engineering-led data delivery; candidates should be able to review designs at pipeline, schema and integration level.
OLAP & OLTP architecture experience - Snowflake and Oracle (or equivalent)
Data architecture and data engineering patterns across batch, event-driven and analytical workloads
Cloud data platform, warehouse and lakehouse architecture
Advanced SQL and strong understanding of ELT/data transformation patterns
Data integration, orchestration, APIs and event-driven architecture
Logical, physical and semantic data design
Data product schemas, interfaces and data contract design
Metadata, data catalogue and lineage implementation patterns
Data security engineering, privacy, identity and access-control patterns
Performance, scalability, workload and cost optimisation
DevOps/DataOps practices, version control, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code awareness
Testing, reconciliation and automation patterns
Technology evaluation, architecture decision records and technical documentation
The type of candidate that we’re looking for:
We’re looking for a Data Architect who can combine strong technical knowledge with a practical, collaborative approach. You’ll have experience designing and delivering modern data solutions and be comfortable turning broad architecture principles into clear, workable approaches that engineering teams can use. You’ll understand how data moves through platforms, how systems integrate, and what good looks like when it comes to security, reliability, scalability and performance.
You’ll enjoy working closely with engineers, analysts and other technology teams, helping to shape standards and patterns that make delivery simpler and more consistent. Experience with modern cloud data platforms, data warehousing, SQL, integration and data modelling will be important, and familiarity with technologies such as Snowflake and Oracle would be beneficial. Most importantly, you’ll be someone who can balance technical depth with pragmatism and communicate your thinking clearly to a range of stakeholders. Critical Skills

Overview of Department
Purpose of Role
The Data Modeller helps create a clear and consistent understanding of data across the organisation. Working with business and technology teams, you’ll define key data concepts, relationships and structures, and turn them into practical models that support data products, analytics and data delivery.
You’ll help make sure data is designed consistently, can be reused effectively and remains easy to understand as the organisation evolves. This includes connecting business definitions with logical and physical data models so that teams can build reliable, well-structured data solutions.
Responsibilities
Business and Domain Discovery - Facilitate identification of key business entities, terminology, ownership and domain boundaries to create a useful map of the data landscape.
Interaction and Dependency Mapping - Make inputs, outputs, data products, interfaces and cross-domain dependencies explicit before detailed modelling begins.
Conceptual Data Modelling - Facilitate modelling of business concepts, domains, entities, relationships and key definitions to create a common language across teams.
Logical Data Design - Produce detailed logical models where they support a clear business or technical purpose, expressing rules, structures, relationships, constraints and definitions independent of technology.
Physical Data Design Support - Translate logical designs into physical structures suitable for databases, warehouses, lakehouses, streaming platforms, APIs and analytical consumption patterns.
Data Product and Contract Modelling - Support product teams in designing product schemas, data contracts, semantic layers and reusable datasets that are understandable and fit for consumption.
Standards and Patterns - Maintain modelling standards, naming conventions, reference data patterns, metadata expectations and reusable templates.
Metadata and Catalogue Integration - Ensure models are connected to catalogue entries, glossary terms, ownership, lineage, quality rules and governance classifications.
Model Review and Assurance - Review models for consistency, appropriate normalisation or denormalisation, extensibility, performance implications, privacy, security and change impact.
Source-to-Target Mapping and Change Impact - Define and validate mappings between source systems, canonical or semantic structures, transformation logic and consuming products, and assess downstream impact of change.
Change Impact Analysis - Assess how changes to data definitions, schemas and relationships affect downstream products, reports, integrations and controls.
What does success look like?
Teams share a common understanding of data. Business concepts, definitions, relationships, ownership and domain boundaries are clearly described and agreed across business and technical teams. Data designs are traceable and change impacts are understood. Models connect to catalogue entries, definitions, lineage and quality rules, with mappings and dependencies making downstream impacts clear.
Logical models are clearly reflected in physical models, leading to efficient, consistent data design practices

### About the Role

The **Commercial Project Manager** will take ownership of Learn to Ride Wales as it moves from its current design and pilot phase towards national rollout.

Working closely with the Chief Executive Officer, you'll oversee the development and delivery of the programme, hold external delivery partners to account and turn the programme's emerging brand and commercial model into a sustainable national programme.

A key part of the role will be developing the franchise network that will enable Learn to Ride Wales to scale delivery across Wales, alongside personally securing and managing significant commercial partnerships.

With national rollout planned for summer/autumn 2027, this is a role for someone who can bring pace, commercial thinking and strong project leadership to a complex, multi-partner programme.

* **Position:** Commercial Project Manager - Learn to Ride Wales
* **Reports to:** Chief Executive Officer
* **Contract:** Permanent, full time
* **Salary:** £40,000-£50,000 per annum, dependent on experience
* **Location:** Hybrid - home based, with a base at Geraint Thomas National Velodrome of Wales, Newport
* **Travel:** Regular travel across Wales and occasional UK travel

Key Responsibilities

As Commercial Project Manager, you will:

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of Learn to Ride Wales, from development and piloting through to national rollout.
* Act as Beicio Cymru's day-to-day representative to the external delivery consortium, ensuring deliverables and timescales are met.
* Manage the programme timeline, budget and risks, reporting regularly to the Chief Executive and relevant Board and Committee meetings.
* Lead the design and national rollout of the LTRW franchise model and secure regional franchise partners across Wales.
* Identify, pitch to and secure franchise partners including local authorities, trusts, schools and community organisations.
* Develop and negotiate franchise agreements and manage ongoing partner performance and relationships.
* Manage Learn to Ride Wales' commercial partners, including the national headline partnership and its activation framework.
* Identify and secure new commercial sponsorship and investment, working closely with the CEO across LTRW and other Beicio Cymru flagship activities.
* Build a growing pipeline of commercial opportunities to support Beicio Cymru's long-term financial sustainability.
* Build strong relationships with Welsh Government, Sport Wales, funders and other key stakeholders.
* Maintain KPI tracking across programme delivery, franchise adoption and commercial income.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an experienced and self-starting professional who can combine strong commercial skills with excellent project and relationship management.

The successful candidate will have:

* Significant experience in project or programme management and/or product development, ideally within sport, commercial partnerships, franchising or a comparable fast-moving environment.
* A demonstrable track record of personally securing and managing commercial sponsorship or partnership deals of meaningful value.
* Strong financial and budget management skills, with experience reporting to senior leadership and/or a Board.
* Excellent relationship management and negotiation skills, with the confidence to represent Beicio Cymru with major corporate and government stakeholders.
* The ability to manage multiple external delivery partners and hold them to account for pace and quality.
* The ability to work independently and under commercial pressure to make a complex, multi-partner programme succeed.

Experience of franchise, licensing or multi-site delivery models would be desirable, as would an understanding of cycling, sport development or a National Governing Body environment. Existing relationships with corporate sponsors, Welsh Government or Sport Wales would also be welcomed.

With the 2027 Tour de France Grand Départ providing a once-in-a-generation opportunity to raise the profile of cycling across Wales, the programme has the potential to inspire a new generation of confident cyclists while creating a sustainable national model for learn-to-ride provision.

Buyside Sales Specialist EMEA: Risk Models & Quantitative Portfolio Analytics

Location

London

Business Area

## Description & Requirements

Our Team

Bloomberg's Portfolio & Risk Analytics business delivers some of the industry's most sophisticated risk management, valuation, portfolio construction, and investment analytics solutions to leading asset managers, pension funds, insurers, hedge funds, and sovereign institutions around the world.

This is powered by Bloomberg's Multi-Asset Class Model (MAC3), a proprietary factor-based risk model designed to help institutional investors understand, measure, and manage portfolio risk across global asset classes. The model provides forward-looking risk estimates and decomposes portfolio risk into systematic market factors and asset-specific (idiosyncratic) risk, providing a comprehensive view of the drivers of portfolio volatility and diversification. MAC3 is also utilized to support portfolio construction and optimization. Investors can use the model to evaluate proposed trades, manage factor exposures, assess diversification, incorporate investment constraints, and understand how changes in portfolio composition may affect overall risk.

Unlike models built for a single asset class, MAC3 is designed to deliver a consistent risk framework across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities, derivatives, and alternatives, enabling investors to evaluate risk and construct portfolios holistically across diversified investment strategies.

We are seeking a highly collaborative, technically sophisticated, and commercially driven Risk Model Sales Specialist to drive the growth of Bloomberg's MAC3 factor risk model datasets in the UK. This is a new-business sales role with accountability for developing a qualified pipeline, acquiring new clients, expanding strategic relationships, and delivering against annual revenue goals.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of financial markets, quantitative analytics, portfolio construction, and enterprise technology. You will partner with some of the world's largest and most sophisticated investment firms.

Acting as a trusted advisor throughout the sales lifecycle, you will lead technical and commercial engagements, uncover client requirements, understand portfolio risk, construction, and optimization workflows, and demonstrate how Bloomberg's MAC3 risk model can address complex investment and enterprise data needs.

You will manage opportunities from initial discovery and qualification through technical evaluation, proposal, negotiation, and close. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Account Management, Legal, and Implementation teams globally, serving as both a market-facing sales specialist and a strategic voice for our clients. Your insights will directly influence product development and help shape the future direction of Bloomberg's risk solutions.

We'll Trust You To:

Drive New Business Growth - Develop and execute strategies to originate new opportunities, acquire new clients, expand strategic relationships, and deliver against quarterly and annual revenue goals.

Build and Manage a Qualified Pipeline - Identify, prospect, qualify, and prioritize opportunities across the client base. Maintain disciplined opportunity management, activity tracking, and forecast accuracy.

Own Complex Sales Cycles - Lead opportunities from initial discovery and qualification through business-case development, RFP and RFI responses, proposals, pricing, procurement, contract negotiation, and commercial close.

Lead Strategic Client Engagements - Develop relationships with CROs, senior risk managers, quantitative teams, portfolio managers, portfolio construction and optimization teams, model validation groups, data and technology teams, and operational stakeholders across leading buy-side institutions.

Translate Investment Workflows into Solutions - Understand how clients use factor risk models for risk estimation, portfolio construction and optimization, factor exposure management, scenario analysis, model validation, and investment oversight. Translate these requirements into differentiated MAC3 data and workflow solutions.

Lead Technical Evaluations - Coordinate tailored demonstrations, methodology discussions, model comparisons, data evaluations, trials, and proofs of concept in partnership with Product, Research, Engineering, and other technical specialists.

Influence Product Strategy - Act as a key conduit between clients and Bloomberg's Product, Engineering, and Research teams by communicating market trends, competitive intelligence, and structured client feedback that helps shape future product development.

Represent Bloomberg's Risk Business - Build Bloomberg's presence in the institutional risk and quantitative investment community through industry events, client forums, and other market-facing engagements.

You'll Need To Have

5+ years of experience selling institutional investment technology, risk analytics, portfolio management, factor model data, or other quantitative solutions.

A demonstrated record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

Strong understanding of factor risk models and their application to risk estimation, portfolio construction, optimization, factor exposure management, and institutional investment decision-making.

Demonstrated success selling into hedge funds or institutional asset managers.

Proven ability to originate new opportunities while expanding strategic client relationships.

Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple technical, investment, commercial, procurement, and legal stakeholders.

Experience leading or supporting risk model evaluations, trials, proofs of concept, RFPs, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

The ability to translate quantitative and technical concepts into clear business value for audiences ranging from quantitative specialists and model validation teams to CIOs, CROs, and technology executives.

Familiarity with enterprise data-delivery and integration considerations associated with quantitative datasets, including file-based delivery, APIs, cloud platforms, or internal analytical systems.

Excellent collaboration, communication, presentation, and organizational skills, with the ability to operate effectively across global, cross-functional teams.

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

At BEX, we're transforming the way hospitality businesses operate. Our software platform helps holiday parks, campsites, hotels and accommodation providers manage reservations, automate processes and deliver exceptional guest experiences.

We work with hospitality businesses across Europe. Our mission is simple: to help hospitality entrepreneurs spend less time on administration and more time focusing on their guests.

As part of our team, you'll join a fast-growing SaaS company where innovation, ownership and customer success are at the heart of everything we do.

You will join a product-oriented engineering team where we value results over process. Working full-stack with **Ruby on Rails**, you’ll build new features that have a direct impact on thousands of users.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers and fellow engineers to translate complex requirements into clean, modular solutions. Whether it's optimizing data flows, maintaining external integrations, or rethinking parts of our architecture to handle future growth, you have the space to take initiative and see your ideas go into production.

You'll report to Thijs Schreijer (Head of Engineering), who values deep technical discussions and Engineers who think along about the strategic direction of the product.

* Design, build, and maintain new platform functionalities, features, and modules
* Optimise existing code for performance, scalability, and maintainability
* Develop and manage robust APIs, integrations, and links to external systems
* Thoroughly test, debug, and document your technical solutions
* Actively shape architectural decisions and contribute to technical discussions
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and cross-functional teams in an agile environment

## About You

You are an experienced Engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and understands what it takes to keep a live system running smoothly.

* Annual salary reviews.
* Hybrid working opportunities

* Access to our LMS, internal training and ongoing development opportunities.
* The opportunity to make a real impact in a growing international SaaS company.

**About the role**

**Create, direct and lead the development and execution of the Peripheral Interventions marketing and sales strategies for the UK & Ireland.** The Business Unit Manager is accountable for overall sales and business performance, including P&L management, market development, customer strategy and people leadership across the PI portfolio. The role establishes and sustains market leadership by selecting the appropriate commercial and GTM models, leading strategic planning through market opportunity assessment and customer segmentation and translating strategy into disciplined execution through the leadership and coaching of sales, marketing and clinical teams.

**The role operates in alignment with Northern Cluster, EMEA and global divisional strategies, ensuring effective product positioning, market penetration, training, forecasting and portfolio execution.** It uses market intelligence, customer insight and financial analysis to broaden Boston Scientific market share, improve customer outcomes and deliver sustainable and profitable growth, while maintaining the highest standards of patient safety, quality, compliance and ethical conduct.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* **Strategy & Market Leadership:** Develop and lead the UKI PI strategic plan, annual operating plan and commercial priorities based on market opportunity assessment, customer segmentation, therapy and portfolio opportunities, competitive dynamics and evolving customer needs. Ensure commercial priorities and field needs are reflected in marketing plans and investments.
* **Customer, KOL & External Stakeholder Leadership:** Build and maintain senior relationships with major accounts, key opinion leaders, economic buyers, procurement stakeholders and relevant external organisations. ### Could this be the role for you?

As a Police Officer with British Transport Police, you'll play a vital role in keeping millions of passengers, railway staff and members of the public safe every day. Working across one of the busiest transport networks in the world, you'll face unique challenges, develop valuable skills and make a real difference to people's lives.

No two days are the same. One moment, you could be supporting a vulnerable person in crisis. The next, you might be responding to an emergency, investigating crime, safeguarding a child, disrupting criminal activity or reassuring someone during one of the most difficult moments of their life.

This is a career where your actions matter. Every interaction provides an opportunity to protect, support and positively impact the communities we serve.

You'll never face these challenges alone. From your first day of training, you'll be supported by experienced colleagues, supervisors and mentors who are committed to helping you develop, succeed and build a rewarding career.

We offer one of the most competitive starting salary packages for Police Constables in England and Wales, alongside excellent benefits, structured career development and opportunities to specialise throughout your policing career.  
  
**What you'll get in return**

A successful policing career is about more than salary alone. At British Transport Police, you'll benefit from competitive pay, industry-leading travel benefits, strong family-friendly policies, comprehensive wellbeing support and ongoing opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.

* **Starting salary:** £33,609, rising year on year to £52,014 after five years
* **London allowances:** £9,044.75 (£5,783.75 London Allowance plus £3,261 London Weighting) from day one of training
* Oyster card for personal and professional use
* 25 days annual leave, increasing with service

* Specialist support from Occupational Health and wellbeing services
* Free eyesight tests

* Membership of the Police Federation from day one

### What we're looking for

You do not need previous policing experience to join us. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds, experiences and stages of life.

Whether you're changing careers, leaving education, returning to work or looking for a fresh challenge, we'll provide the training, support and development you need to succeed. There is no single background that makes a great police officer. Some of our officers join directly from education, while others bring valuable experience from careers in healthcare, customer service, retail, hospitality, transportation, the military and many other professions.

What matters most is your integrity, commitment to helping others and willingness to learn. If you care about people, enjoy working as part of a team and want to make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. While every day brings different challenges, successful officers are often people who communicate effectively, remain calm under pressure and can build positive relationships with people from all walks of life.

* Strong communication skills
* Sound judgement and problem-solving ability
* Empathy and emotional resilience
* The ability to build trust and remain calm under pressure

**Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP)**

Successful candidates will join the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), British Transport Police's two-year entry route for new police officers.

You do not need a degree to apply and you will not be required to complete a degree as part of the programme.

PCEP combines classroom learning, remote learning, scenario-based training and practical operational experience to equip you with the knowledge, skills and behaviours needed for frontline policing.

During training, you'll learn how to:

* Use policing powers lawfully and effectively
* Prevent and investigate crime
* Protect vulnerable people
* Respond to incidents and emergencies
* Support victims and witnesses
* Keep passengers, railway staff and local communities safe

As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to specialise in areas such as CID, Counter Terrorism and County Lines. Whether you aspire to become a detective, join a specialist unit, develop as a leader or continue building expertise in frontline policing, we'll support your ambitions every step of the way.

**Entry Requirements**

To be eligible to apply for the Police Constable Entry Programme (PCEP), you must have:

* Level 2 qualifications in English Language and Maths (GCSE Grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent qualification), or be willing to undertake BTP's Level 2 English and Maths assessment if you do not currently hold these qualifications; and
* Either:
  + Hold a Level 3 or above, or
  + Have relevant work experience demonstrating an equivalent level of knowledge, responsibility and professional capability.

If you do not currently hold a Level 2 qualification in English and/or Maths, British Transport Police can provide an assessment to enable you to demonstrate the required Level 2 standard as part of the recruitment process.

Examples of Level 3 qualifications include:

* Two A-levels at grade E or above (or equivalent, such as a BTEC Level 3, Level 3 T Levels or International Baccalaureate).
* BTEC National Diploma
* NVQ Level 3
* Access to Higher Education Diploma
* Other recognised Level 3 qualifications
* Policing experience: at least 12 months' relevant experience, including service as a Special Constable (independent patrol status), PCSO and staff.

We recognise that qualifications are only one measure of potential. If you do not hold a Level 3 qualification, we may consider relevant work experience as an alternative route into policing.

Relevant work experience (24 months service) in one of the following areas:

* Armed Forces / Military service
* Emergency services (e.g. ambulance, fire)
* Revenue Protection Officer / Revenue Inspector
* Railway Enforcement Officer
* Rail Incident Response or Service Delivery Management roles

Candidates will be required to provide evidence of their qualifications and/or experience during the recruitment process.  
  
**You will not be eligible to apply if:**

* You do not hold Level 2 English Language and Maths qualifications (GCSE Grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent qualification).
* You cannot demonstrate either a Level 3 qualification or relevant work experience equivalent to Level 3.
* You have been unsuccessful following your application, testing or interview for Police Officer, Special Constable or PCSO and have not yet completed the three-month reapplication period.
* You have been declined/refused vetting in the last two years by BTP or any other police force, NCA, CNC or MOD.
* You have ever received a custodial sentence, including suspended sentences.
* You have previously been dismissed from another police force or are subject to a live misconduct investigation.
* You are bankrupt, have a County Court Judgment, or an unmanaged Individual Voluntary Arrangement.
* You have tattoos deemed offensive (face and neck tattoos are considered on a case-by-case basis).
* You do not have permanent right to live and work in the UK.
* You have not resided continuously in the UK for the past three years.

Applications are completed online.

As part of the process, you will be required to complete a Situational Judgement Test & also an Ethic Situational Judgement Test. If you do not pass the SJT assessments, your application will not progress at this time, though you may reapply once the reapplication period allows.

You are encouraged, though not required, to attend a question-and-answer session to learn more about the role, life at BTP and the recruitment process.

Successful applicants will join a conditional offer pool and be considered for opportunities for up to 12 months from the date of their conditional offer.

### Equality, Diversity and Inclusion

We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to thrive.

Whatever your background, identity or experience, you'll be supported throughout the recruitment process and throughout your career with British Transport Police.

# Introduction to Role & Team

Badoo is one of the world's largest dating apps, connecting millions of people across the globe. It's a mature, much-loved product with enormous reach, and we're in the middle of an ambitious chapter: modernising the experience, sharpening how we help members find real connections, and building a healthier, more sustainable business.

As a Senior Product Designer on Badoo, you'll help shape that next chapter. You'll take end-to-end ownership of meaningful surfaces - onboarding, people discovery, chatting,, and the monetisation experiences that sit alongside them - designing for a global, diverse, and value-conscious membership. This is high-craft product design under real-world constraints: a lean, fast-moving team, an experiment-led culture, and a design foundation we're actively rebuilding.

You'll be a key voice at the intersection of product, engineering, research, and data - balancing sharp product thinking and strong craft with commercial pragmatism and a deep respect for the people who use Badoo. If you're energised by scale, comfortable making trade-offs explicit, and want your work to move both member and business outcomes, this is a rare canvas to work on.

# What You’ll Do

* Own end-to-end design for multiple Badoo surfaces leading the work from discovery and problem framing through interaction design, visual polish, and delivery.
* Design experiences that balance member value with commercial impact: paywalls, consumables and subscription flows that feel fair and clear. Monetisation is central to Badoo's roadmap, and great design is what makes it work for members and the business.
* Work in an experiment-led way. Most meaningful changes ship as A/B tests with clear hypotheses and guardrails, so you'll design for iteration and learning, not just a single polished hand-off, and stay close to the results.
* Help modernise Badoo's design foundations. Our design system is a work in progress; you'll contribute patterns and components that raise consistency and quality across a large, mature product.
* Collaborate closely with PMs, UXR, data science, and engineers to frame problems, validate hypotheses, synthesise insights, and evolve designs based on evidence, accepting that data is sometimes imperfect and that judgment matters.
* Ship pragmatically within a lean team. Prioritise for member and business outcomes over perfection, make trade-offs explicit, and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.
* Design for a global, inclusive audience - a diverse international membership across many markets, languages, and devices - and for platform and compliance requirements as they evolve.
* Apply AI-powered tools and methods to accelerate exploration, improve accessibility, and personalise experiences responsibly.
* Give and receive design critique with precision and care while elevating the work around you and modelling a culture of high craft standards.
* Model Bumble’s core competencies: collaborate with purpose, take ownership, adapt with agility, and deliver from insight to impact.
* Embody our values of Courage, Respect, and Joy in how you work and the experiences you create.

# About You

* You’re an experienced end-to-end product designer with a track record of delivering thoughtful, high-quality mobile experiences from ambiguity to release.
* You have a strong product mind: you frame problems before jumping to solutions, connect design decisions to user and business outcomes, and think in systems as much as screens.
* You're commercially fluent and comfortable designing monetisation experiences that feel fair, and are a well-crafted part of the product rather than a bolt-on.
* You thrive with constraints. You're pragmatic about scope, comfortable in a lean and fast-moving team, and energised by working on a mature product that needs modernising.
* You're at home in an experiment-driven environment: designing for A/B tests, iterating on results, and reasoning under uncertainty in a two-sided marketplace where impact is hard to predict.
* Your visual and interaction design craft is strong, your work is polished, considered, and reflects a deep understanding of what makes digital experiences feel right.
* You bring real intentionality to your process: from how you frame a problem to how you design a transition, your work shows rigour, purpose, and care.
* You balance user empathy with commercial pragmatism and know when to push for the ideal experience and when to ship a well-reasoned version.
* You’re fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools and you use them to think as well as to communicate.
* You’re grounded in inclusive design principles and accessibility standards, and you bring a global mindset to your work.
* You’re curious about AI’s role in product experiences and you apply these tools with ethical care and creative intention.
* You take full ownership of your work: you drive things to a conclusion, communicate proactively, and build trust with partners across disciplines.
* Typically requires 5-8 years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

* Enjoy building custom connectors or automations for SaaS apps and cloud infra.

**Cellular Origins**

Cell therapies are changing how we treat some of the most devastating diseases, by using a patient’s own cells as the treatment. To bring these therapies to many more people, manufacturing must change too, becoming far more scalable, reliable and efficient. At Cellular Origins you’ll help build the firmware that drives our robotic manufacturing technology, so more patients can access life-changing treatments sooner.

As a Senior Firmware Engineer, you’ll sit at the intersection of software, electronics and automation. You’ll take technical ownership of turning motion, sensing and control ideas into reliable, production-ready firmware that keeps our systems running smoothly in a bioprocess environment. You’ll regularly see your code make motors move, sensors respond and complex systems run reliably.

## Job Description

You’ll join a multidisciplinary team of engineers and scientists working on our core automation platform, from first prototypes through to production systems. You’ll design, implement and test firmware that runs on ARM microcontrollers, work directly with hardware on the bench, and help shape technical decisions across firmware, electronics and the wider system.

This is not a role confined to the firmware team: you may spend as much time working with electronics, mechanical, automation and systems engineers, and with biologists, as you do with other firmware or software engineers. You’ll need to enjoy crossing disciplinary boundaries and learning enough about the wider system to help make it work as one coherent whole.

In this role, you’ll:

* Own firmware development for key parts of our core technology, from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification and support in production.
* Write and review high-quality C for ARM microcontrollers (primarily STM32), focusing on robust, maintainable and testable code.
* Design and maintain automated tests for embedded firmware, including unit, integration and hardware-in-the-loop, and integrate them into continuous integration workflows.
* Turn system needs into clear firmware requirements and interfaces, working directly with electronics, mechanical, automation and software engineers, plus biologists.
* Make and communicate technical decisions within your area, balancing engineering rigour, maintainability and delivery speed, and support other engineers through design discussions and code reviews.
* Debug complex embedded-system issues using tools such as debug probes, oscilloscopes, multimeters and logic analysers, getting to the root cause of tricky problems.
* Use Linux-based tools and development environments as part of your day-to-day work.
* Support and occasionally develop custom test equipment for internal use, helping the wider team move faster.
* Use higher-level languages such as Python, C# or Java to build supporting tools and simple GUIs for debugging, testing or internal users.

Depending on your experience, you may also:

* Turn your hand to electronics design and prototype modification when needed, working with electronics engineers to shape interfaces and resolve cross-discipline issues.
* Develop and optimise hard real-time algorithms for motion control, sensing or safety-critical functions.
* Use Docker and containers to create reliable, repeatable development and test environments.
* Contribute to embedded Linux software and the interfaces between it and our microcontroller firmware.

## Qualifications

**About you**

You enjoy seeing firmware come to life in real hardware, and you like being close to the bench, motors and sensors rather than hidden away from the physical system. You are comfortable owning firmware end to end, from first requirements and architecture through to code that ships, and you get energy from solving problems with people from different technical backgrounds.

We’re looking for:

* A strong track record of designing and delivering embedded systems, with the judgement to take ownership and make pragmatic technical decisions independently.
* Extensive professional experience developing firmware in C and/or C++ on ARM microcontrollers, ideally STM32.
* Strong experience developing and maintaining automated tests for embedded systems, including using them within continuous integration workflows.
* Confidence working directly with hardware and independently debugging complex systems at both code and signal level.
* Strong skills in interpreting component datasheets and electronics schematics, and using them to inform design and debugging.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, support other engineers and solve problems with people from very different disciplines.

* Experience modifying infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform) or contributing to production data pipelines.

# Market Data Analyst

Cognitive Credit is expanding the Market Data Team that oversees the integrity of the bond and loan pricing and reference data that underpins our Global Credit product.

We are looking for a market data analyst who is frustrated working in a large institution, enjoys solving puzzles, likes to build automated processes, and has a fine attention to detail.

The analyst will have a background in evaluated pricing, independent price verification (IPV), fixed income trade support, or credit fund valuations. The analyst will work closely with our product and engineering teams to ensure the accuracy of the market data we deliver to clients.

We are a financial technology company that develops advanced analytics software for global credit investors.

Our clients are the world's largest investment banks, asset managers, and hedge funds.

An ideal candidate for this position will be comfortable with bond and loan price and reference data syntax, confident calculating fixed income analytics, and will bring the intelligence, puzzle-solving instinct, and proactivity needed to find the one wrong number in a very large dataset.

**This job is for you if:**

* you are frustrated by the pace and bureaucracy of large institutions
* you enjoy puzzle-solving – you have an instinct for spotting the outlier that everyone else's process missed
* you are highly analytical, detail-oriented, motivated by data integrity challenges, and can work independently
* you would rather build automated market data checks than keep running them by hand
* you know how to calculate YTM, YTW, z-spread, duration (Macaulay and Modified), and PV01 with ease
* you understand how bond and loan pricing conventions work (clean vs. dirty price, accrued interest, day count) well enough to sanity-check a price against its fundamentals
* you know how to leverage, but are not overly reliant on, the latest AI technologies
* you are excited by and curious to learn what Cognitive Credit’s proprietary Market Data Pipeline does

**Required Education/Experience/Skills:**

* Experience in evaluated pricing, independent price verification (IPV), fixed income valuations/trade support, or credit fund NAV pricing
* Work experience as an investment bank IPV or vendor-side pricing analyst
* Strong familiarity with bond and loan reference data syntax and pricing feed structures
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, including building complex spreadsheets with Macros/Apps Scripts
* Demonstrated ability to work through large, messy datasets to identify pricing outliers and data errors
* Strong academic track record; sharp analytical and quantitative reasoning
* General interest in technology, especially as applied to financial market data
* An understanding of corporate capital structures, simple and complex, is a plus
* Coding experience in Python, SQL, or a similar language for data analysis is a plus

**Typical Day:**

* Reviewing pricing feeds received from our third-party pricing data provider against internal benchmarks and investigating anomalies
* Sifting through large bond and loan price and reference datasets to identify, prioritize, and resolve outliers
* Calculating and validating various bond and loan pricing data at scale
* Tracing capital structures and inter-company relationships to ensure aggregate-level data integrity
* Building automated algorithms that reduce manual reviews and checks
* Documenting and escalating recurring data quality issues to our pricing vendor and internal stakeholders
* Interacting with our clients, the world's leading investment firms, to answer questions about data and product functionality

**Compensation:**

Competitive pay and benefits, subject to individual experience.

**Work Environment:**

Dynamic, innovative, analytical, and collaborative.

**Location:**

The parent company is based in London, UK. The position can offer remote working flexibility.
