# Emerging Talent Advisor

1. People, Culture & Performance

London, United Kingdom

Company Description

  

Colliers is a leading commercial real estate services company, providing a full range of services to real estate occupiers, developers and investors on a local, national and international basis. Our UK business is headquartered in London, with over 1,300 specialists across 16 offices in the UK and Ireland.

  

Job Description

  

Role Purpose

The Emerging Talent & Talent Development Advisor coordinates and manages the post-join experience for graduates, apprentices, interns and other early-career colleagues across the UK business. Approximately 60% of the role is focused on the operational delivery and continuous improvement of Emerging Talent activity, including induction, rotations, professional qualifications, apprenticeships, internships, cohort engagement, performance support, programme records and key annual milestones. The remaining 40% contributes to wider Talent & Development priorities, including business skills, learning facilitation and capability-building. Working across Talent & Development, Talent Acquisition, HR Administration, HR Business Partners and the business, the postholder ensures participants, managers and stakeholders receive a consistent, well-governed and high-quality experience aligned to Colliers’ People & Culture strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Emerging Talent programme management: Coordinate the annual operational cycle for graduates, apprentices, interns and other early-career colleagues, maintaining clear plans, milestones, communications and handoffs across Talent Acquisition, Talent & Development and HR Administration.
* Induction and onboarding: Plan and deliver the annual Emerging Talent induction, including agendas, speakers, invitations, materials, attendance, dietary requirements, catering, building access, regional travel and accommodation, the cohort mixer and team-building activity; act as a visible host and facilitator throughout.
* Rotations and placement: Manage scheduled graduate rotation cycles, consult participants on preferences and competency needs, assess business capacity, coordinate decisions with Heads of Department and regional offices, and maintain accurate placement and costing information.
* Newly Qualified process: Maintain the pipeline of colleagues approaching qualification, confirm anticipated APC sit dates and proposed NQ departments, coordinate seat approvals, work with HR Business Partners and HR Administration on salary, bonus, title, contract and cost-code changes, and support referred candidates through the agreed process.
* Professional qualifications: Coordinate RICS enrolment, candidate subscriptions, APC counsellor allocation, structured training, CPD and submission milestones; monitor progress and liaise with candidates, managers, training partners and professional bodies to resolve issues promptly.
* Apprenticeships: Coordinate enrolment with training providers, maintain records on the Digital Apprenticeship Service, monitor protected off-the-job learning and levy position, support business-direct apprentice requests, and administer pauses, stops or changes where required.
* Internships and placements: Manage the post-selection internship and placement experience, including onboarding, induction, group projects, manager guidance, feedback and transition into the Early Assessment Centre or future graduate pipeline, working closely with Talent Acquisition and participating departments.
* Performance and participant support: Act as a key point of contact for participants and managers, providing clear guidance on programme expectations, development milestones, available support and emerging performance matters, escalating appropriately and involving HR Business Partners where needed.
* Cohort engagement and outreach: Coordinate cohort engagement activity, including the Emerging Talent Challenge, mixers, social events, schools engagement and agreed diversity and outreach commitments, ensuring clear briefs, governance and stakeholder involvement.
* Pay-cycle administration: Prepare accurate annual scheme salary-review and bonus data for graduates and apprentices, validate eligible populations with HR Business Partners, and hand approved changes to HR Administration for processing; support the NQ pay process without independently setting or approving remuneration.
* Business skills and wider Talent & Development: Facilitate or co-facilitate learning for Emerging Talent and wider colleague groups, create practical resources and communications, contribute to professional skills, leadership, mentoring, digital capability and other agreed Talent & Development priorities, and actively contribute to the Early Careers strategy and its ongoing development within wider Talent & Development initiatives.

**Core Programmes and Activity Areas**

* Emerging Talent induction, onboarding, annual communications and participant support.
* Graduate rotations, department placement, costings and Newly Qualified transitions.
* RICS enrolment, APC progress, counsellor allocation, professional training, CPD and qualification outcomes.
* Apprenticeship provider coordination, Digital Apprenticeship Service administration, levy monitoring and off-the-job learning requirements.
* Summer internships, placements, Early Assessment Centre handover and future-talent pipeline support.
* Scheme salary-review and bonus administration, working with HR Business Partners and HR Administration.
* Cohort engagement, the Emerging Talent Challenge, schools engagement and agreed diversity and outreach activity.
* Emerging Talent inbox, central tracker, programme records, shared documentation and management information.
* Business skills facilitation and wider Talent & Development activity, maintaining the intended 60% Emerging Talent and 40% broader delivery balance.

**Key Stakeholders**

* Head of UK Talent & Development and the wider Talent & Development team.
* Talent Acquisition, HR Administration, HR Business Partners and other People & Culture colleagues.
* Graduates, apprentices, interns, placement students and other early-career colleagues.
* Heads of Department, Heads of Office, line managers, graduate managers, supervisors, APC counsellors, mentors and buddies.
* Senior leaders and subject matter experts involved in induction, programme delivery, assessment or cohort events.
* Professional bodies, universities, apprenticeship providers, specialist trainers and outreach partners.
* Finance, Marketing, Facilities, IT and other internal teams supporting systems, events, budgets, communications and logistics.

  

Qualifications

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Behaviours**

* Strong interest in learning, development, talent development, employee experience and organisational culture.
* Confidence facilitating or co-facilitating learning sessions, with the ability to create an inclusive, professional and engaging environment for participants.
* Excellent organisation and prioritisation, with the ability to manage multiple programmes, events, deadlines and stakeholder needs.
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messages for participants, managers and senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including responsiveness, relationship-building, follow-through and collaborative working.
* Good understanding of colleague development needs, business skills capability and the learning approaches required to support people at different career stages.
* Analytical capability and attention to detail when managing programme data, participant records, feedback and evaluation outputs.
* Good digital confidence, including Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word and shared document libraries.
* Discretion and professionalism when handling employee, participant or programme information.
* Curiosity, initiative and a continuous improvement mindset, with an active interest in how Early Careers is evolving within Talent & Development and the confidence to contribute ideas that strengthen strategy, learning activity and the participant experience.

**Success Measures**

* All induction, rotation, qualification, apprenticeship, internship and NQ milestones are planned, communicated and delivered to the agreed annual timetable.
* The central Emerging Talent tracker, inbox and shared records are current, accurate and maintained as reliable sources of programme information.
* Participants understand their pathway, placements, qualification requirements, key dates and available support, with queries answered or routed promptly.
* Rotation and NQ decisions are supported by complete preference, competency, seat, costing and qualification data, with timely stakeholder confirmation.
* RICS, APC, university and apprenticeship enrolments and progress requirements are completed accurately and within provider deadlines.
* Salary-review and bonus data is prepared accurately, appropriately approved and handed to HR Administration in time for processing.
* Managers and key stakeholders receive clear, timely and practical communications, with risks and exceptions escalated early.
* Learning sessions, induction activity and cohort events are delivered professionally and receive positive participant and stakeholder feedback.

# Data Governance, Privacy & Enablement Counsel

We usually respond within a week

Collinson is a global loyalty and benefits company.

We use our expertise and products to craft customer experiences which enable some of the world’s best-known brands to acquire, engage and retain the most demanding and choice-rich customers. In particular, our unique expertise and insight into high earning, frequent travellers allow us to create products and solutions for our clients that inspire greater customer engagement to drive more profitable relationships, enrich their travel experiences, protect what matters, and assist in in times of need.

While specialising in Financial Services, Travel and Retail, we also support clients in multiple sectors. We have worked with over ninety airlines, twenty hotel groups and more than six hundred financial institutions and banks, with clients including Accor Hotels, Air France KLM, American Express, British Airways, Cathay Pacific, Diners Club, Mandarin Oriental, Mastercard, Radisson Hotel Group, Sephora, Visa and Vhi.

We take our 30 years’ experience working with these kinds of household names in over 170 countries and help our clients to deliver the smarter experiences it takes to differentiate their propositions and help them win deeper devotion with their customers.

Collinson is a privately-owned entrepreneurial business with 2,000 passionate people working in twenty locations worldwide. Our solutions include Priority Pass, the world’s best known airport experiences programme, while we are also the trusted partner behind many of the leading financial services, airline and hotel brand’s reward programmes and loyalty initiatives.

**Purpose of the job**

The role provides expert legal advice and strategic support on all aspects of data protection, privacy and information governance across the Group. The role ensures that the organisation's data strategy, governance framework and commercial initiatives are underpinned by robust legal and regulatory compliance while enabling the responsible and innovative use of data.

As a member of the wider legal team, the role will be working closely with the Data Enablement Officer, Data Protection, Information Security, Compliance, Technology and Business teams, the role embeds **privacy by design**, supports **enterprise data governance**, facilitates **secure data sharing**, and provides day-to-day legal advice on privacy and contractual data protection matters across our operating companies.

The role acts as a trusted legal partner to the business, enabling commercial initiatives through practical, solutions-oriented advice.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Support the Group Data Enablement Framework**

* Provide legal support in the development and maintenance of the Group Data Enablement Framework.
* Ensure legal and privacy requirements are embedded within enterprise data governance standards, policies and processes.
* Advise on accountability obligations, lawful processing principles and privacy-by-design requirements across data initiatives.
* Support governance committees and decision-making forums on legal aspects of data management.

**Review Contracts and Commercial Arrangements**

* Review, draft and negotiate contracts involving the processing or sharing of personal data.
* Ensure contractual arrangements appropriately allocate privacy obligations and regulatory responsibilities.
* Provide legal support on supplier, customer and technology agreements involving personal data.

**Provide Day-to-Day Legal and Data Protection Advice**

* Act as the primary legal contact for operational data protection and privacy queries from business stakeholders.
* Provide timely advice on subject access requests, retention, lawful basis, marketing, customer complaints, employee data and operational privacy issues.
* Support business projects by providing practical legal solutions to day-to-day data protection matters.

**Support Enterprise Data Architecture and Data Pipelines**

* Provide legal advice on new data flows, system integrations and enterprise data architecture initiatives.
* Advise on privacy implications relating to data minimisation, purpose limitation, retention, security and lawful processing.
* Review new technologies and transformation programmes to ensure privacy risks are appropriately managed.

**Support Data Cataloguing and Accountability**

* Advise on legal requirements relating to Records of Processing Activities (ROPAs), data inventories and data classification.
* Support documentation of ownership, lawful basis, retention periods and processing purposes for key business data assets.
* Ensure accountability obligations under GDPR are appropriately embedded within enterprise data cataloguing initiatives.

**Support Customer Insight and Commercial Opportunities**

* Provide legal advice on the lawful use of customer data for analytics, profiling, segmentation, AI and commercial initiatives.
* Advise on consent requirements, legitimate interests’ assessments and direct marketing obligations.
* Support responsible innovation while protecting customer rights and maintaining regulatory compliance.

**Advise on AI and Emerging Technology Initiatives**

* Provide privacy and data protection legal advice on the Group's AI initiatives, including generative AI tools, machine learning models and automated decision-making systems.
* Advise on the lawfulness of AI-driven processing.
* Support the development of internal AI governance frameworks and policies, ensuring privacy-by-design principles are embedded from the outset.
* Monitor developments in AI regulation and advise on their implications for the Group's activities.

**Manage Data Breach and Incident Response**

* Lead the legal response to personal data incidents and breaches, including severity assessment and advising on regulatory notification obligations.
* Manage notifications to the ICO within statutory timeframes and coordinate any required communications to affected data subjects.
* Coordinate breach response with Information Security, Compliance and Communications teams to ensure a timely and legally robust response.
* Manage proactive and reactive engagement with the ICO, including regulatory investigations and formal inquiries.

**Deliver Privacy Training and Awareness**

* Design and deliver privacy training and awareness programmes tailored to business stakeholders across the Group.
* Support embedding a culture of data protection across the organisation through accessible, practical guidance and communications.

**Knowledge, skills, and experience required**

**Knowledge**

The successful candidate will demonstrate extensive knowledge of:

* UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. The Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 and its implications for data sharing, smart data schemes and research exemptions.
* Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR).
* UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) guidance and regulatory expectations.
* EU GDPR and international privacy frameworks where applicable.
* Data Processing Agreements, International Data Transfer Agreements (IDTAs) and Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs).
* Records of Processing Activities (ROPAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs).
* Customer data governance, profiling, marketing permissions and consent management.
* Emerging technologies including Artificial Intelligence, automated decision-making and data ethics.
* Enterprise data governance frameworks and the interaction between legal, compliance, technology and business functions.

**Skills**

The successful candidate will be able to:

* Provide pragmatic, commercially focused legal advice on complex data protection issues.
* Draft, review and negotiate contracts involving personal data processing and sharing.
* Interpret legislation and regulatory guidance and translate it into practical business solutions.
* Influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex legal concepts in a simple and accessible manner.
* Build collaborative relationships across Legal, Data Protection, Technology, Information Security, Compliance and Commercial teams.
* Analyse complex data processing activities and identify legal and privacy risks.
* Support strategic data governance initiatives and privacy-by-design programmes.
* Manage multiple priorities and provide responsive legal support across a diverse business.
* Exercise sound judgement when advising on new or high-risk data initiatives. Demonstrate a solutions-first mindset, identifying compliant pathways to commercial objectives.

**Experience**

The successful candidate will have:

**Essential**

* Qualified Solicitor (England & Wales) or equivalent legal qualification.
* Minimum 5 years' post-qualification experience advising on UK data protection and privacy law.
* Strong experience leading or supporting enterprise data transformation or digital transformation programmes.
* Significant experience reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts involving personal data in multiple jurisdictions (ideally, with considerable APAC experience).
* Significant experience leading the drafting and negotiation of:

  + Data Processing Agreements
  + Data Sharing Agreements
  + International Data Transfer Agreements
  + Standard Contractual Clauses
  + Technology and outsourcing agreements
  + Transfer Risk Assessments

* Experience advising on customer data, marketing, profiling and consent management.
* Experience responding to day-to-day operational privacy queries from business stakeholders.
* Deep experience in providing advice under pressure on breach assessment, notification thresholds, ICO/Regulatory reporting, data subject communications, internal investigations, remediation and post-incident governance.
* Substantial experience gained within an in-house legal function.
* Experience advising on personal data breach response, including regulatory notification obligations to the ICO and management of third-party and data subject notifications.

**Desirable**

* Experience advising on AI governance, machine learning or automated decision-making.
* Experience supporting international organisations and cross-border data transfers.
* Experience implementing or supporting enterprise data governance frameworks.
* Experience working with data cataloguing tools, metadata management or Records of Processing Activities (ROPAs).
* Experience training non-lawyers, influencing stakeholders and embedding privacy controls into business processes.
* Experience engaging with the ICO or other data protection regulators, including managing regulatory investigations or formal inquiries.
* Relevant privacy certification such as CIPP/E (IAPP) or equivalent.

Growth engineer and marketing engineer both appeared once the people who understood the funnel could write the code that ran it, and forward deployed engineer appeared when the same thing happened to enterprise delivery. None of the three was a rename. They exist because splitting the person who understands the process from the person who builds it stopped paying for itself.

Retail Engineer is that title for catalog operations. Most of the people who fit it have spent five or six years in solution consulting or solution delivery at a retail software vendor or a consultancy. They read business processes for a living and they own the customer, and almost all of them have a technical side they were never given room to use: the configuration screen ended exactly where the interesting part started, and everything past it went to a development team on another continent.

What changed is the platform. The agents are built there, changed there and run there, so the person who designs the workflow is the person who builds it, in front of the customer, in the same week. You write the prompts and you wire up their systems, and when a number moves you go and change whatever produced it. AI coding assistants work alongside you, so a change that used to take a sprint becomes a prompt and a test.

The half of the job you were already good at stays. Discovery, a room full of stakeholders, an account that trusts you: here that is what keeps the building honest, because you are the one who heard what they actually meant. What you gain is the other half. You spend your days on agent design, evals and prompt engineering, inside a company that runs its own operations on agents, which is a faster education in this than anything you could sign up for.

## Why this role is different

It is not pure delivery and it is not pure engineering. You sit at the intersection: you understand the retailer’s catalog workflow well enough to redesign it around agents, and you have the depth to build the agent flows yourself.

You cover the whole lifecycle. The preparation, mapping their processes, designing the workflow, writing and iterating the prompts, defining the KPIs. Then the run, deployment, integration with their systems, monitoring, debugging, and optimization against those KPIs.

And you do not only deliver. You shape how we deliver and you grow the engineers around you, so one senior hire lifts the team instead of adding a pair of hands. You work closely with the Agent Product Managers, who own the product direction, and with the AI Engineers on delivery.

## What you would do

* Lead agent implementations end to end for enterprise retailers, from kickoff to production, on our DIPE method: design, implement, prove, evolve.
* Own our most strategic accounts and the heaviest proofs of concept directly.
* Define the success KPIs with the customer, and build the measurement loop that proves the agents are working.
* Design and build the agent workflows, and write the prompt layer that drives them.
* Integrate agents with customer systems: PIM, ERP, ecommerce platforms, marketplaces, data warehouses.
* Own the run. Monitor, debug, iterate on prompts and flows, and move the numbers over time.
* Structure how we deliver, and grow the engineers around you, so the team scales on method instead of drowning.
* Feed what you learn back into the product and the agent roadmap.

## What we are looking for

### Essential

* Three or more years of experience, most of it in consulting or solution delivery. Many of our best fits are management engineers who read a business process and enjoy working with data.
* You sit between business and technology. You can redesign a retailer’s catalog workflow and build the agent flow yourself. Not a pure PM, not a pure data engineer.
* Prompt engineering sense. You iterate against real data, you measure output quality, and you know when to fix something with a prompt and when to fix it with code.
* Standing with enterprise customers, and a record of bringing complex delivery home.
* You have managed projects and people, and you still want to build rather than only coordinate.
* Customer-facing and high agency. You handle ambiguity, you lead the conversation with the retailer, and you do not wait for a perfect brief.
* English to native standard, and you are at home in the UK market. Italian is a plus.

### Preferred

* Hands-on with workflow builders such as n8n, and with AI-native coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex.
* Comfortable coding with AI assistance, in Python or TypeScript, to glue systems together and extend what an agent does.
* You have worked with a workflow orchestration engine.
* Deep retail workflow knowledge: catalog management, PIM, assortment, attribute governance, channel publishing, marketplace operations.
* The major PIM platforms, Akeneo, Salsify, inRiver, Pimcore, and the feed and channel managers.
* A background as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Implementation Lead or technical CSM at an enterprise software company.
* Retail data quality at scale: millions of SKUs, many languages, many marketplaces.

## The team you would join

Our founders have spent their careers building and operating retail at scale. They have founded retail companies generating tens of millions in revenue, launched and scaled Amazon’s operations in Italy and Spain, led operations at Everli across more than 2,000 employees, and shaped product direction at Shopify and Zalando. Operator, founder, product leader. Every seat that defined modern European commerce.

## What we offer

* Ownership. Your work reaches production and customers fast, and shapes the delivery method directly.
* Growth. A high-leverage team, real commercial complexity, tight feedback loops.
* An ambitious roadmap. Help define the operating infrastructure for agentic commerce in Europe.
* A new craft. You learn to build and ship with agents and AI coding assistants, and it compounds.
* Flexible hybrid. The London hub, three days a week minimum, plus four remote weeks a year.

Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query.

* Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval
* Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB
* Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it
* Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture
* Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps

*This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our* ***Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia*** *office.*

You bring:

* At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM

## About us

Cronofy is the temporal infrastructure layer at the heart of how work gets done. We've spent over a decade building the orchestration layer that keeps workflows in step – unifying availability control, coordinating the full scheduling lifecycle, and unlocking meeting intelligence. Trusted by 400 leading SaaS products and powering over 180,000 businesses worldwide, including GoDaddy, Indeed, Wise and Squarespace.  
  
As every business races to unlock actual outcomes from AI, the infrastructure connecting agents, systems and teams has never mattered more. Every person who joins our distributed team – headquartered in Nottingham with offices in London and Amsterdam – can have a direct hand in shaping what comes next, with real opportunity to grow fast for those who share our principles.

## The role

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting directly to our VP of Marketing. You'll own the pipeline that comes from being found: organic search, AI assistants and answer engines, and the organic distribution we build over time. How people research B2B products has changed more in two years than in the previous ten – buyers ask AI assistants, read answers instead of results pages, and arrive at vendors having already formed a view. We think that's an opportunity for whoever encodes their story best, and this role exists to win it.   
  
You won't be a solo creator producing content in a corner. You'll run a growth engine: an editor powered by AI who raises the pace and quality of everything we publish, partners with subject matter experts across the company and our customer base to make their knowledge legible, and empowers the rest of the team to create high-quality content themselves – campaign assets, enablement pieces, ad copy – through the briefs, templates and workflows you build, so quality scales without you becoming the bottleneck. You'll be the filter for what good looks like: copywriting quality, taste, and whether a piece has earned its place.

## How you'll work

* Organic pipeline: Own how Cronofy gets discovered and cited across search engines and AI assistants (SEO and AEO) – one of our largest and best converting sources of pipeline. Set the strategy, execute the plan, and be accountable for the growth in pipeline.
* Distribution engine: Build the organic reach that means our content works harder than its first publish – how it travels through LinkedIn, communities, newsletters and the people who carry it. This is not something we excel at, so you'll get to truly design it rather than inherit it.
* AI-powered: You believe that AI doesn’t automatically mean AI slop, but use AI as a force multiplier for research, drafting and analysis as well as empowering others around you to get high quality content faster – behaving more like an editor than an isolated copywriter. We've invested heavily in our Claude Code workspace: you'll make the most of it and directly build and extend skills and agents, while developing our tone of voice and holding ourselves to a high standard.
* Partnership with experts: Our best content often comes from subject matter experts – founders, engineers, salespeople, customers. Interview them, mine recorded customer calls, and turn what they know into content with a point of view.

Expected outcomes within 12 months: a measurable increase in organic pipeline against the baseline we'll share with you, a proven distribution model we can scale, and an effective content system the rest of the team visibly uses.

## Who we think you are

You're a writer and editor with a point of view, who treats search and AI answer surfaces as the distribution layer for good thinking rather than a game to be played. You have taste, and you can defend it. You're curious enough to interview an engineer about API architecture in the morning and a recruiter about interview scheduling in the afternoon, and honest enough to kill a piece that isn't working. You love creating to engage an audience, and bring an experience in building and growing an audience already. You believe AI raises the floor of content production, which makes human judgment about what's true, interesting and different the scarcest input – and you're excited rather than threatened by that.

## Your capabilities

* Experience: 5+ years in B2B content, SEO/organic growth, or both.
* AI: you can demonstrate the skills you’ve built and what you learned in the process – and are excited about the possibilities without being naive about the challenges and shortcomings.
* Craft: You can show us published long-form where you clearly understood the subject rather than paraphrasing it – and tell us what it changed for the business.
* Search fluency: You’ve seen first hand how search engines and AI assistants find, judge and cite content, and you've acted on it despite a fast evolving space. You don't need to be a technical SEO – you need to know what makes content get retrieved and quoted.
* Editorial leverage: You've edited other people's work (human or AI-drafted) to a standard, and can describe your bar.
* Mindset: Accountable to a number, comfortable with ambiguity, and biased to publish and learn over polish and delay.

## How we work

Our principles guide how we approach everyday.   
  
We work hard but insist that everyone considers the balance between work and their life and responsibilities outside. We are direct in our dealings with each other. We continuously work to build mutual trust so that we can give each other feedback without fear of it being taken personally.   
  
We can support a predominantly remote, office-based or hybrid working model. We do really value face-to-face time and, where circumstances allow, encourage teams to spend regular time together at suitable locations. As our current Marketing team is based in London (near London Bridge), the successful applicant should be based in, or within a reasonably commutable distance, to the London city centre.

## Hiring process

1. A 30-minute screening call with our VP of Marketing.
2. A 1-hour interview with our VP of Marketing to explore your experience and approach.
3. A panel-based discussion including a practical task and principle fit evaluation.

## What we offer

* Pension scheme matched at 5% (gross)
* 25 days holiday in addition to flexible national holidays. National holidays are added to your holiday allowance and you're not required to take them on the corresponding day.
* 6 personal development days per year to use for learning and development, charitable causes or similar

# Senior Executive Assistant

## Be at the heart of decision-making. Support the CEO, Chairperson and Board while helping shape the future of executive support at Cynergy Bank.

*Shape**the**future**of**executive**support**at**Cynergy**Bank.*

Join us as a **Senior****Executive****Assistant** and become a trusted partner at the heart of Cynergy Bank. Supporting our most senior leaders and helping connect our Executive Assistant community, you will have the opportunity to influence how executive support is delivered across the Bank.

This is a high-profile role for an accomplished Executive Assistant who combines exceptional organisational skills with sound judgement, discretion and a passion for improving how people work.

###### What’s the Opportunity?

Reporting to the Chief People and Culture Officer, you will provide proactive, high-quality executive support to the CEO, Chairperson, Board and senior Executive Committee stakeholders.

Alongside this core responsibility, you will act as a visible lead across our Executive Assistant community, building stronger connections, championing consistent standards and helping create a cohesive executive support service.

This is not a formal people management position. Your impact will come through influence, credibility, coaching and leading by example. You will also help the function embrace AI and digital tools thoughtfully, identifying practical ways to improve planning, communication, workflow management and meeting effectiveness while maintaining the discretion and governance expected within a regulated bank.

###### Where You Will Work

This role is based in our **Central****London****office** and has a greater on-site requirement than our standard hybrid working model.

You will work:

* Four days each week in the office
* One day each week from home
* Five days in the office during one week each month, to support Board coverage

The successful candidate must be comfortable working within this pattern, reflecting the highly visible and relationship-led nature of the role.

###### Why Join Us?

###### We know the best people want more than just a job. At Cynergy Bank, you will find:

* **Influence:** Work closely with the CEO, Chairperson, Board and senior leaders, with the opportunity to improve how executive support operates across the Bank.
* **Innovation:** Help shape the practical and responsible use of AI and digital tools within the Executive Assistant community.
* **Variety:** Operate across executive priorities, Board and Committee activity, communications, events, governance and business-wide initiatives.
* **Growth:** Strengthen your leadership profile through influence, coaching and cross-functional collaboration.
* **Rewards:** A competitive salary and benefits package designed to recognise your skills and contribution.

###### How You Will Make an Impact

* Provide proactive, high-quality executive support to the CEO, Chairperson and Board, anticipating requirements and managing complex priorities with confidence and discretion.
* Take ownership of sophisticated inbox and diary management, ensuring senior leaders’ time remains focused on the Bank’s strategic priorities.
* Act as a senior point of coordination across the Executive Assistant community, promoting collaboration, consistent standards and shared ways of working.
* Coordinate CEO, Executive Committee, Board and Committee meetings, including agendas, logistics, papers, action tracking and follow-through.
* Support effective communication between the CEO’s office, senior leaders, Board Directors, UK regulators and other key stakeholders.
* Champion best practice across diary management, meetings, travel, events, executive communications and stakeholder engagement.
* Identify practical opportunities to use AI, automation and digital tools to reduce manual effort, improve consistency and enhance the executive support experience.
* Encourage the responsible adoption of new technology across the Executive Assistant community by sharing learning and leading by example.
* Coordinate travel, appointments, events, business functions and CEO-led colleague communications, ensuring arrangements and supporting materials are delivered to a high standard.
* Lead or contribute to projects, research and process improvements that strengthen the effectiveness and resilience of the Executive Support function.

###### What You Will Bring

* Significant experience as a Senior Executive Assistant supporting a CEO, Chairperson, Board or similarly senior stakeholders.
* Experience working with Boards, Committees and senior governance forums, ideally within financial services or another regulated environment.
* Exceptional inbox, diary, meeting and workflow management skills, with the ability to anticipate needs and manage competing priorities at pace.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the credibility, judgement and discretion to engage confidently with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* A collaborative and influential leadership style, with experience improving processes, establishing consistent ways of working and bringing colleagues together without formal authority.
* Confidence using Microsoft 365, AI, automation and digital productivity tools, combined with the curiosity and sound judgement to apply technology safely and effectively.

###### How We Will Support You

**About the division:**
Our Investment Banking & Capital Markets (IBCM) business provides the full range of advisory and financing products and services of a leading global investment bank. Our clients include large-cap and mid-cap corporates, financial institutions, governments, government agencies and financial sponsors.

We recognize that selecting the right investment banking partner can be the key to a company's success. Our relationships are enhanced by industry sector, country and regional expertise, closely aligned to high-quality client solutions. We offer both buyside and sellside advisory services for mergers and acquisitions, restructuring advisory, debt and equity capital raising services (including our dedicated Environmental Social Governance (ESG) solutions) and structured equity transactions. We advise on innovative cross-border and regional transactions in the US, Europe and Asia Pacific.

**About the role:**
As an IBCM Graduate in the UK Coverage Team, you will work closely with senior bankers and product specialists to help our clients achieve their strategic and financial objectives. While responsibilities will vary depending on the transaction and client, your role may include:

+ Performing in-depth company and industry research and analysis
+ Supporting the execution of client advisory and financing transactions across public and private M&A, IPOs, Equity Capital Markets and private fundraising, while coordinating multiple workstreams across local and international teams
+ Preparing marketing materials and transaction documentation, including but not limited to confidential memoranda, board papers, pitch books, corporate profiles, and analytical materials
+ Building and maintaining detailed financial models, valuations and forecasts to support strategic advice and transaction execution
+ Supporting public clients through market analysis, preparation of investor materials and supporting their interactions with investors, developing a strong understanding of how mid and large-cap companies enhance shareholder value, access capital and pursue strategic opportunities
+ Regular engagement with listed corporate clients through Deutsche Bank's Corporate Broking franchise by providing market insights, shareholder analysis and preparation of investor materials
+ Working closely with Equity Research, Equity Sales and IBCM Product teams to support public clients, originate opportunities and contribute to IPO and broader capital markets mandates.
+ Building strong relationships with clients through regular day-to-day interaction and exposure to management teams, investors and other key stakeholders
+ Developing a broad understanding of Deutsche Bank's product suite and how the wider platform can be leveraged to deliver integrated solutions for clients

**Areas in which you could work within UK Coverage:**

**- Generalist Broking & Advisory, Consumer, Business Services and Industrials, Building Property and Real Estate (BPRE), Technology, Media and Telecom (TMT), Investment Companies**

**What we look for:**
We recruit students and graduates who have:

+ a strong foundational knowledge and interest in global capital markets, corporate finance, macroeconomics and accounting
+ confident, constructive and effective communication skills
+ strong interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage with clients and contribute to day-to-day client relationships
+ an ability to solve problems, organize tasks and manage multiple projects with demanding timelines
+ strong attention to detail and accuracy
+ an interest and ability to work collaboratively across the Deutsche Bank platform and global teams in support of our clients

A formal financial background isn't required. Our comprehensive training programs will provide you technical skills you'll need to build a career with us.

**To be eligible for the 2027 Graduate Program you must:**

+ Complete your studies (all final exams, coursework and have no outstanding requirements for graduation) between 1st January 2026 and 31st July 2027.
+ Be able to start full time work in July 2027, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.
+ You should also be on track for a 2:1 or First (or equivalent) in your undergraduate degree.
+ Possess no more than 12 months full-time, relevant work experience.
+ For some placements within IBCM, in addition to English, fluency in a European language is desirable.

Feeling healthy, engaged and well-supported, enables us to do our best work and get the most out of life outside of the office. That's why Deutsche Bank is committed to providing benefits and programmes centred around wellbeing.

# Senior Integration & Automation Engineer

**About the Devonshire Group**

The Devonshire Group comprises the Devonshire family interests, charities and businesses throughout the UK and Ireland, including Chatsworth in Derbyshire, the Bolton Abbey Estate in North Yorkshire, the Lismore Estate in County Waterford, and the Compton Estate in Sussex.

# 

Across our estates and businesses, we operate visitor attractions, shops, restaurants and luxury accommodation, alongside tenanted residential and commercial property, farming and forestry enterprises, and a significant property development pipeline. We employ around 1,400 colleagues across more than 65,000 acres.

# 

We are committed to benefitting heritage, people and a shared future, preserving and enhancing our heritage assets, supporting our communities, and leading by example in how we do things.

# 

**About the role**

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Devonshire Group as our Senior Integration & Automation Engineer, taking a leading hands-on role in connecting and modernising the business systems that keep a complex, multi-site organisation running.

# 

Working alongside the Solutions Delivery & Automation Lead, you will design and deliver the integrations, data flows and automated processes that join up our finance, retail, hospitality, property and operational systems. You will also take our Power Platform estate from ad-hoc solutions to a governed, documented and dependable environment that the whole Group can rely on.

# 

This is a Microsoft-centred engineering role and the senior technical delivery capability in a small IT team. Where the Lead sets architecture and direction, you will own delivery - designing the solution, building it, integrating it, supporting it and reviewing the work of others. In time you will deputise for the Lead on technical matters, and there is real scope to shape how we work as the function grows.

# 

This is a full-time role working five days a week from either the Chatsworth Estate Office, near Edensor, Derbyshire or from Bolton Abbey, near Skipton, Yorkshire (with at least one day a week working from the Derbyshire office), depending on your location. Hybrid working will be available with flexibility to meet business needs. There will be some travel to other Devonshire Group locations.

# 

**What you'll be doing**

* Designing and delivering secure, reliable integrations between business systems, cloud services and third-party platforms using APIs, connectors, middleware and file transfer.
* Building and supporting solutions across Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Copilot Studio and SharePoint Online.
* Establishing proper application lifecycle management - environments, managed solutions, Dataverse Git integration, pipelines, release and rollback - and the integration standards the rest of the team builds against.
* Modelling, moving and validating data between systems, and building reporting on top of it using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
* Supporting and improving what you and others have built, including through our busiest visitor periods.
* Translating business needs into clear technical designs, and being straight with colleagues about cost, effort and trade-offs.
* Producing high-quality solution designs, technical documentation and support materials that a colleague could pick up.
* Reviewing and mentoring the work of colleagues in IT and citizen developers across the Group.
* Retiring legacy tools and reducing the number of systems we have to keep alive.
* Deputising for the Solutions Delivery & Automation Lead on technical decisions.

# 

**About you**

You’ll take pride in systems that work reliably for years rather than solutions that demo well. You’ll enjoy untangling how things currently work, spotting where an integration will fail before it does, and leaving behind something a colleague could pick up and support without you.

# 

You’ll be comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, able to explain a constraint to someone who doesn’t want to hear it and keep the relationship intact. You’ll bring a genuine interest in developing others, and the confidence to review a colleague’s design and improve it. You’ll also be realistic about the shape of our business - it is seasonal, our hospitality and retail systems matter most at exactly the times other people are on holiday, and some of what you inherit will need untangling before it can be improved.

**We're looking for someone who has:**

* Substantial hands-on experience delivering business system integrations in a Microsoft environment.
* Power Platform experience at solution level - managing environments, managed solutions, ALM, Dataverse and data loss prevention policies, not just building apps and flows.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly SharePoint Online and Teams.
* Modern integration methods: REST APIs, OAuth 2.0 and Entra ID authentication, standard and custom connectors, middleware, scheduled and event-driven file transfer, and proper handling of failure and retry.
* SQL beyond basic querying, confidence with relational data models, and experience building reporting with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
* A track record of supporting systems they built over a period of years, including incident response.
* Evidence of mentoring or developing colleagues, and of reviewing others’ technical work.
* Enough AI literacy to review, integrate, operate and constructively challenge tooling built by others.
* An understanding of security, identity, governance and data protection in cloud environments.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
* Confident communicating with technical and non-technical colleagues, including explaining a constraint to someone who doesn’t want to hear it.

# 

**It would be beneficial to have:**

* Azure integration and data services such as Data Factory, Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus or Event Grid.
* Scripting experience in PowerShell or Python.
* Experience integrating with EPOS, hospitality, property management or finance platforms.
* Experience integrating with a system that was being replaced underneath them.
* Relevant current Microsoft certifications.
* A valid UK Driving Licence.

# 

You’ll join a supportive and friendly IT team within a values-led organisation that genuinely cares about its people, with unusual variety in the work - farming and forestry, visitor attractions, hospitality and luxury accommodation, tenanted property and a significant development pipeline, across four estates in two countries. We’ll support your development with certification and training, and this role offers a clear path towards broader technical leadership as the function grows.

# Senior Delivery Health and Safety Manager

**A little bit about us**East West Rail is an infrastructure programme connecting communities between Oxford and Cambridge, a region currently underserved by transport. We have a once in a generation opportunity to improve prosperity for people and places across the corridor.

East West Railway Company was created by the Department for Transport to oversee delivery of East West Rail, from construction through to wheels in motion, ensuring the railway comes together in the right way.  
  
**Role Summary**

The Senior Delivery Health and Safety Manager plays a key leadership role within the Health, Safety and Security function, supporting the Director of ETS and the Head of HSS in setting strategic direction, driving consistent standards, and embedding a positive health, safety and security culture across the programme and all delivery operations.  
  
The role combines strategic leadership with day-to-day management of the Delivery HSS team, providing direction, coaching and assurance to ensure health, safety and security risks are effectively managed and behaviours align with organisational values. Acting as a trusted partner to the Head of HSS, the role helps translate EWR strategy, guiding principles and the HSMS into delivery, influences senior stakeholders, and leads continuous improvement across the function, delivery teams and suppliers.  
  
**Function**

The Health, Safety and Security function sets EWR Co's strategic direction for health, safety and security, working with the Director of ETS and Head of HSS to embed consistent standards and a positive safety culture across the programme and delivery operations. The function provides leadership, coaching and assurance across the Delivery HSS team, and works closely with delivery partners and suppliers to ensure risks are effectively managed.

## Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

* Support the Head of Health, Safety and Security set strategic direction, translating priorities into clear requirements for the Delivery HSS team and ensuring effective implementation against agreed objectives and milestones.
* Act as a senior point of contact for health and safety matters, representing the function at programme, project and leadership forums.
* Shape and maintain governance, assurance and reporting arrangements that give the Executive team confidence in health and safety performance and risk management.
* Provide day-to-day leadership of the Delivery Health and Safety team, including workload planning, prioritisation and performance management, and lead quarterly performance conversations that set clear, measurable objectives.
* Coach and develop team members, building capability, confidence and professional competence across the function.
* Drive a systematic approach to risk management, strengthening assurance frameworks and embedding a proactive safety culture across the business.
* Champion positive safety leadership and behaviours at all levels, setting clear expectations and role-modelling the standards required.
* Maintain oversight of day-to-day Delivery health and safety activity across all projects, providing senior support and constructive challenge in managing incidents, investigations, audits and assurance activities.
* Build and maintain relationships with senior leaders, project teams, delivery partners and external stakeholders, providing pragmatic advice that integrates health, safety and security considerations into planning and delivery.
* Oversee supply chain compliance and performance, ensuring robust governance and consistent delivery of safe, high-quality outcomes across all suppliers.
* Represent the HSS team at key meetings and forums, including Working Groups, PMEC and industry forums, and build relationships with regulators such as the ORR, HSE and Network Rail.
* Promote and embed EWR's Safe and Secure guiding principles across the project lifecycle, acting as a role model and taking responsibility for your own and others' health, safety and security.

## Skills Knowledge and Expertise

**Essential Criteria**

You will bring:

* A background in a senior health and safety leadership role within a complex delivery environment, ideally in infrastructure, construction, rail or utilities.
* Involvement in developing and implementing health and safety management arrangements on large scale, multi-disciplinary rail and major civils projects.
* Skill in leading and managing teams, including coaching, performance management and capability development.
* Strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate strategy into practical, operational delivery.
* Experience embedding culture and behaviour change programmes.
* Stakeholder management and influencing skills, with confidence operating at senior leadership level.
* Sound judgement and the ability to provide balanced support and challenge.
* In-depth knowledge of health and safety regulations, standards and best practice.
* A NEBOSH National Diploma for Occupational Health and Safety Management, or an equivalent qualification such as a Diploma in Safety Management (DipSM) from the British Safety Council, or MIRSM.

**Desirable Criteria**

It would also be great if you have:

* A NEBOSH General Certificate, or equivalent experience.
* Assurance, audit or investigation competence.
* Membership of a relevant professional body.
* Knowledge of general health and safety legislation.
* Knowledge of railway-specific legislation and standards, including Railway Group Standards and Network Rail Company Standards, where applicable.
* Confidence using health and safety reporting systems.

## Benefits

* Competitive salary that reflects your skills and experience
* Up to 12% employer pension contribution to support your future
* 36 days annual leave (including bank holidays) plus the option to buy up to 2 extra days
* 2 volunteering days, a chance for you to give back to the community
* Enhanced family-friendly policies to support you and your loved ones
* Life assurance (4x your annual salary) for peace of mind
* Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support when you need it
* Access to Perkbox for a wide range of discounts and wellbeing benefits
* Recognition programme, including on-the-spot and annual awards
* Advanced learning and development opportunities to help you grow.

**Diversity and Inclusion**  
At East West Railway Company, we’re committed to building an inclusive railway for all. We believe that to do that, we must nurture a diverse team that represents the UK communities that we impact. Our approach is simple - to create an environment where everyone is welcome and able to be themselves. We celebrate diversity and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer,  encouraging applications from all backgrounds and experiences.

If you want to connect lives and unlock the future, then we’d love to hear from you.

## About East West Rail

East West Railway Company is a new and exciting venture at the forefront of the changing landscape of the rail industry, delivering substantial fast-paced improvement to modernise the railway.

Scientific Climate Ratings is the first climate risk rating agency, born from EDHEC’ renowned academic expertise in finance. Following the landmark sale of Scientific Beta to the Singapore Stock Exchange and the recent acquisition of SIPA by PEI Group, we are now entering an exciting scale up phase.

  

We are hiring a Senior Sales to accelerate the growth of our solutions for financial institutions, corporates and public entities across the UK. You will lead new business development, turning market demand for climate risk intelligence into concrete business outcomes.

  

Reporting to the Head of Sales, you will own the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract, and work together with product, research, and leadership teams. You will also help shape our go-to-market strategy and contribute to thought leadership in a rapidly evolving regulatory and market environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Business Development**

* Own and drive new business activity across UK and US prospects: financial institutions, asset managers, insurers, corporates, and public sector entities.
* Identify, qualify, and progress opportunities through proactive market outreach and leveraging your existing UK and US network.
* You will be responsible for delivering against ambitious revenue targets in the UK and US markets, focusing on high-value, complex sales cycles with senior stakeholders across financial institutions and corporates.
* Lead discovery sessions, deliver tailored demos and compelling presentations to senior stakeholders.
* Build and nurture long-term, trusted client relationships that generate recurring revenue and referrals.
* Continuously refine the go-to-market approach based on market feedback and competitive intelligence.

**Commercial Execution**

* Drive pricing proposals and lead contract negotiations through to close.
* Ensure smooth onboarding and implementation through close coordination with product and technical teams.
* Collaborate with consulting, product, and modelling teams to tailor solutions and uncover upsell opportunities.
* Maintain accurate pipeline management in the CRM and deliver regular strategic business reviews to leadership.

**Market Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the voice of the client internally, translating market insights into product and strategy inputs.
* Partner with product, consulting, marketing, and leadership teams throughout the sales cycle.
* Stay current on UK and US regulatory developments, competitive dynamics, and ESG data trends.
* Represent Scientific Climate Ratings at client meetings, industry conferences, and events to build brand visibility.
* Support sector-focused campaigns, outreach initiatives, and thought-leadership content.

**Who You Are**

You are a commercially driven sales professional with a proven ability to win new business. You combine a client-driven mind with genuine curiosity for climate and finance topics, and you are energised by the idea of selling a product that genuinely matters.

You are organised and disciplined in your approach, skilled at managing long sales cycles, and adept at building relationships at senior decision-maker level. You are motivated by client satisfaction and by contributing to the company growth.

**What You Bring**

* Master’s degree in business, Finance, or a related field
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in a sales or business development role within financial services, ESG data, or climate finance
* Strong experience in client-facing roles
* Proven track record of managing full sales cycles and closing new business
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
* Ability to tailor messaging and value propositions to different stakeholders
* Proactive, fast learner with a strong deal-driven mindset
* Experience with CRM platforms and account management tools
* Native English (required), proficiency in an additional European language is a strong plus
* An existing network within the UK market is a strong advantage

**What We Offer**

* A senior, high-impact role at the forefront of climate risk intelligence
* Full ownership of the UK and US sales cycle, with direct access to senior leadership and meaningful input on go-to-market strategy
* A stimulating environment at the crossroads of rigorous academic research and real-world commercial application
* Collaboration with world-class researchers, policymakers, and industry leaders
* Competitive salary and package benchmarked to market standards, reflective of experience
* Based in our London office at Blackfriars, with a collaborative and international team

**About Scientific Climate Ratings & EDHEC**

EDHEC Business School has been recognised for over 20 years for its expertise in finance. Beyond its academic pursuits, EDHEC has ventured into the business world with remarkable success. Notably, it launched "Scientific Beta," a smart index provider sold to the Singapore Stock Exchange for over 200 million euros in January 2020. Following this achievement, EDHEC introduced "Scientific Portfolio" and "Scientific Infra & Private Assets," expanding its footprint in analytics and ESMA- regulated financial services.  SIPA has been acquired by PEI Group in March 2026, highlighting again the credibility of such EDHEC ventures for the market.

  

Reflecting its continuous effort to leverage academic and business expertise to make an impact, EDHEC, via its Climate Institute, produces significant research, enabling the creation of new ventures such as Scientific Climate Ratings - the first climate risk rating agency - which brings its unique data and ratings on climate risk financial materiality to the market.

  

Join a fast-growing structure with high ambitions, where proactivity and team spirit are rewarded. As an EDHEC venture, we benefit from EDHEC's academic leadership and propose attractive salaries based on market practices.

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter (pdf format) explaining your interest in the role and how your background aligns with our mission.

# Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI Native (f/m/d)

*York, UK*

Edmund Optics® is a leading manufacturer and supplier of optics, imaging, and photonics technology. Edmund Optics` state-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities combined with its global distribution network has earned it the position as being one of the largest supplier of off-the-shelf optical components and a trusted partner when it comes to customized solutions. Supporting numerous markets around the globe, including advanced diagnostics, semiconductor & electronics, machine vision, automation, and R&D; Edmund Optics products are used in a variety of applications ranging from DNA sequencing to retinal eye scanning to high-speed factory automation.

Edmund Optics Europe, a US owned-group consisting of Edmund Optics subsidiaries in Germany, UK, Netherlands and France, is responsible for sales, marketing, distribution, engineering and application support for a wide product range throughout Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Europe is one of the main growth markets for Edmund Optics globally, leading to a rapidly expanding and developing local team.

To accelerate our success and growth within the European Market, Edmund Optics Ltd. is looking for a

## **Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI Native (f/m/d)**

  
The Senior E-commerce Backend Engineer: AI-Native is responsible to build, integrate, and expand the backend services that power the company's evolving modular e-commerce platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on connecting core e-commerce capabilities including personalization, semantic and LLM-driven search and discovery, Digital Asset Management (DAM), Product Information Management (PIM), and internal SAP/HANA systems. The role will design and develop APIs, services, data flows, and integrations that allow these platforms to work together reliably at scale. A defining requirement for this position is an AI-native development mindset: the successful candidate will use AI coding agents as a normal part of the software development lifecycle to generate, refactor, test, debug, document, and improve code while applying strong engineering judgment, security practices, and human review. The ideal candidate combines strong backend engineering fundamentals, systems integration experience, curiosity, and the ability to move quickly in a modern AI-assisted development environment.  
  

### Essential Functions:

* Backend Platform Development: Design, build, maintain, and extend backend services, APIs, and integration layers that support Edmund Optics' modular e-commerce architecture and customer-facing web experiences
* AI-Native Software Development: Use AI coding agents and agentic development workflows as a core part of day-to-day engineering to generate, refactor, test, debug, document, and accelerate production code. Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, maintainability, and performance rather than treating generated code as automatically production-ready
* E-commerce Systems Integration: Integrate key e-commerce capabilities including personalization platforms, semantic/LLM search and discovery, DAM, PIM, analytics and data services, and other modular components as the e-commerce ecosystem evolves
* Enterprise Data & ERP Integration: Build and maintain reliable integrations between the e-commerce platform and internal enterprise systems, including SAP/HANA, product, pricing, inventory, customer, order, and other business data required to support e-commerce experiences and transactions
* API & Service Architecture: Develop scalable, secure, well-documented APIs and services that allow internal applications, third-party platforms, and customer-facing experiences to exchange data efficiently and consistently
* LLM & Semantic Capabilities: Partner with e-commerce, search, data, and AI teams to integrate LLM-enabled and semantic capabilities into the site, including retrieval, product discovery, conversational experiences, and supporting data pipelines or service layers
* Quality, Testing & Debugging: Build automated testing and validation into development workflows. Use AI-assisted debugging where appropriate while maintaining strong standards for code review, observability, performance, regression prevention, and production reliability
* Modular Architecture & Reusability: Develop services and components with clear boundaries, reusable interfaces, and maintainable integration patterns that support continued movement toward a more modular and composable e-commerce architecture
* Vendor & Partner Collaboration: Work directly with technology vendors, implementation partners, and internal teams to understand technical requirements, review integration approaches, troubleshoot issues, and translate platform capabilities into production solutions
* Continuous Improvement & Emerging Tools: Stay current with AI-assisted software development, agentic coding workflows, backend architecture, integration patterns, and emerging e-commerce technologies. Evaluate new approaches pragmatically and adopt those that measurably improve engineering speed, quality, or maintainability

### Qualifications:

To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

### Your profile:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered
* 7+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial hands-on backend, API, or systems integration work
* Experience working with SAP and/or SAP HANA data and integration patterns
* Demonstrated recent experience using AI-assisted or agentic coding workflows in real software development, not solely experimentation or prompt-based prototyping
* Strong hands-on backend software engineering experience building production web applications, services, APIs, and integrations
* Strong engineering judgment and demonstrated ability to use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools to write, refactor, test, debug, and document code as part of a professional software development workflow
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, service integrations, data interfaces, and modern backend application patterns
* Experience integrating multiple enterprise or SaaS platforms within a production web or e-commerce environment
* Strong understanding of databases, data modeling, SQL, system-to-system data flows, error handling, and integration reliability
* Experience with source control, automated testing, code review, CI/CD practices, logging, monitoring, and production troubleshooting
* Ability to work effectively with frontend developers, architects, product and e-commerce teams, data teams, enterprise application owners, and external implementation partners
* Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and comfort working in an evolving environment where architecture and tools will continue to change
* Ability to communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Fluency in English

### What we offer:

A versatile and challenging position alongside a highly competitive employment package within our dynamic and successful corporation in a growing and future-proof industry. You will have the opportunity to work with highly motivated, self-driven and open-minded people with a great team spirit.

Edmund Optics provides a range of employee benefits alongside the salary package including:

* Company pension scheme
* Private medical & dental insurance
* Extensive training and development opportunities
* Subsidized gym membership
* Cycle to Work scheme
* Company events
* ...and a lot more!

Please send your applications to hr-uk@edmundoptics.co.uk.

The vision of the GBI is to lay the foundations for engineering biology, and unlock its potential for good. To achieve this, we must overcome two key challenges. First, we need the ability to write in the natural language of biology, enabling the rapid and scalable synthesis of entire genomes with precision. Second, we must understand what to write - determining which DNA sequences will generate biological systems that perform the desired functions. Addressing these challenges will allow us to harness the full power of biology to create transformative solutions across health, agriculture, clean energy and more.

* Investigate financial variances and identify underlying performance drivers.

* Experience within professional services, consulting or project-based environments preferred.

* Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting and profitability analysis.

## **Who we are looking for**

Define and establish a **unified “One State Street” data architecture**, including enterprise data domains, reusable data assets, and a clear multi-year roadmap—enabling consistent, AI-ready data across all businesses and functions.

The Head of Data Architecture is accountable for creating a **cohesive enterprise data architecture** that spans State Street’s full business landscape, including:

* Investment Services
* Investment Management
* Wealth
* Alpha platform
* Global Markets
* Corporate and control functions

This role works deeply across business and technology to **understand domain-level data structures, flows, and usage**, and synthesize them into a **single, integrated enterprise architecture view**.

A core focus is to **identify, standardize, and drive adoption of reusable data assets and enterprise definitions**, ensuring that the organization benefits from shared, consistent, and high-quality data across use cases, platforms, and business lines.

The role defines both the **target-state architecture** and the **practical transformation journey**, ensuring that current fragmented data landscapes evolve into a well-structured, scalable, and AI-ready ecosystem.

Success is measured by **clarity and adoption of enterprise data architecture, reuse of data assets across domains, and enablement of scalable data and AI platforms**.

## **What you would be responsible for**

### **Enterprise Data Architecture Vision & “One State Street” Blueprint**

* Define and maintain the **enterprise data architecture vision and target state**
* Develop a unified **“One State Street” data architecture blueprint**, integrating:
  + All business domains
  + Cross-functional data flows
  + Platform-aligned data structures
* Create **clear architectural representations** that simplify the enterprise data landscape

### **Deep Business Domain Alignment**

* Partner closely across:
  + Investment Services
  + Investment Management
  + Wealth
  + Alpha platform
  + Global Markets
  + Control functions (Finance, Risk, Compliance, Operations, etc.)
* Build deep understanding of:
  + Business processes
  + Domain data models
  + Data usage and dependencies
* Translate domain complexity into **standardized enterprise data models and structures**

### **Enterprise Data Domains & Modeling**

* Define and standardize:
  + Enterprise data domains and sub-domains
  + Domain ownership boundaries
  + Conceptual and logical data models
* Ensure consistency and interoperability across domains
* Enable domain-oriented architecture aligned to modern principles (e.g., data products and reuse-first design)

### **Reusable Data Assets & Enterprise Definitions**

* Lead identification and standardization of **reusable data assets across the firm**
* Define and promote **enterprise-level data definitions and canonical data structures**
* Drive reuse of:
  + Core data entities (e.g., client, instrument, transaction, position)
  + Data products and datasets
* Partner with Data Platform Products (Role 4) to ensure reusable assets are:
  + Easily discoverable
  + Accessible and consumable
* Drive adoption across businesses to maximize enterprise value from shared data

### **Data Asset Mapping, Classification & Transparency**

* Establish a comprehensive view of **enterprise data assets across all domains**
* Define consistent frameworks for:
  + Data asset classification
  + Domain tagging
  + Business vs. technical metadata
* Ensure visibility into:
  + What data exists
  + Where it resides
  + How it is used
* Partner with Governance (Role 1) on classification alignment without owning policy

### **Data Architecture Roadmap & Transformation Journey**

* Define a **multi-year data architecture roadmap** from current to target state
* Identify:
  + Redundant and fragmented data assets
  + Opportunities for consolidation and reuse
  + Critical architecture gaps
* Sequence transformation in alignment with:
  + Strategy & Portfolio (Role 2) priorities
  + Platform delivery roadmaps
* Ensure architecture is actionable and tied to real execution

### **Standards, Patterns & Architectural Guidance**

* Define enterprise standards for:
  + Data design and modeling
  + Data integration and interoperability
  + Data product structure
* Establish reusable architecture patterns that enable:
  + Platform scalability
  + AI-ready data design
* Provide clear guidance to engineering and platform teams without owning delivery

### **Collaboration with Platforms & Technology**

* Partner deeply with:
  + Data Platform Products
  + AI Platform Products
  + Enterprise architects within GTS
* Ensure architecture is:
  + Technically feasible
  + Consistent across environments
  + Scalable for enterprise AI use

### **Enterprise Influence & Alignment**

* Act as the **enterprise authority on data architecture**
* Drive alignment across business and technology stakeholders
* Promote a **reuse-first, domain-driven data culture** across the firm

### **Team Leadership**

* Lead a **global team of ~10–15 data architects**
* Build capabilities in:
  + Domain architecture
  + Data modeling
  + Enterprise data design
* Foster a culture of:
  + Deep business engagement
  + Practical, execution-oriented architecture
  + High-quality, consistent outputs

## **Qualifications & Experience**

* Senior leadership experience in **data or enterprise architecture** within financial services
* Strong knowledge of State Street–relevant domains:
  + Custody and fund services
  + Asset management
  + Trading and markets
  + Wealth and client servicing platforms
* Deep understanding of:
  + Modern data architecture patterns
  + Distributed and platform-based data ecosystems
* Proven ability to:
  + Define enterprise-wide architecture frameworks
  + Influence across complex, federated organizations
* Strong blend of **business domain expertise and technical depth**

## **Leadership Profile**

* Enterprise architect with strong business acumen
* Able to unify fragmented landscapes into **cohesive, simple architectures**
* Influential leader who drives alignment without direct control
* Balances strategic clarity with execution realism
* Strong communicator capable of articulating the “big picture” clearly
